description:
**Kody Technolab Limited**

**AI/ML Lead (7+ Years Experience)**

Ahmedabad / Gandhinagar

7+ Years

cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions. The ideal candidate will have

strong expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, MLOps, and

cloud-based AI deployments.

• Stay updated with emerging trends and research in AI, ML, Deep Learning, and Generative AI.

Mathematics, or a related field.

• 7+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML product development.

• Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks including Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and

Hugging Face.

• Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, GANs, VAEs, diffusion models, and prompt engineering.

• Experience with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Docker, Kubeflow, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Fine-tuning and deployment of Large Language Models.

**Why Join Kody Technolab Limited?**

title: Robotics system engineer
description:
**MYSA TECHNOLOGY PVT. LTD.**

Regd. Office: 910, Elite Magum, Near Bhuyangdev Cross Roads, Ahmedabad, Gujarat - 380052

CIN: U72900GJ2020PTC113362 · saakh.in · join@saakh.in

**Ref:**
MYSA/HR/2026-27/ROB-111
**Date:**
3 October 2026

**INVITATION TO APPLY · 2 ROBOTICS SYSTEMS ENGINEERS · FULL-TIME OR**

**INTERNSHIP-TO-FULL-TIME**

Dear Future Robot Builder,

We are opening a
**Robotics & Physical AI Lab**
in Ahmedabad, and right now it is a table. On that table are NVIDIA

Jetson boards, cameras, a LiDAR, motors, microcontrollers, a
**Bambu Lab H2D AMS Combo**
and a DGX Spark in the

corner. What it does not have yet is a robot.

That is the job. Two of you, turning that table into machines that can see, navigate, speak, and keep working after you have

gone home. Mysa builds AI-first products from Ahmedabad -
**Saakh**
, India's AI-led B2B intelligence platform,
**Swar**
for

voice-first medical records,
**MamaMate**
for the Indian household. All of them live on a screen. This one will not.

We care far more about what you have built than how long you have worked. Six months and an autonomous Jetson robot

on video beats four years of generic application development. That is not a platitude - it is literally how we will sort the

applications.

**The bits you'll read twice.**

**Position**
Robotics Systems Engineer · Robotics & Physical AI Lab

**Seats 2 open.**
Apply once; we will place you.

**Two ways in (a) Full-time**
, 1-3 years of relevant building.
**(b) Internship-to-full-time**
, six months paid, for

exceptional freshers and self-taught builders, converting on performance.

**Salary (CTC)**
Full-time:
**Rs. 50,000 - 75,000 per month**
, placed on evidence, not on years.

Internship lane:
**Rs. 25,000 per month**
for six months, then the band above.

**Reports to**
Arpit Golechha, Founder - directly. No layer between you and the decision.

**Location**
Ahmedabad · on-site · six days a week. Robots do not debug over video call.

**Equipment**
All provided - Jetson devices, cameras, LiDAR, sensors and microcontrollers, a
**Bambu Lab H2D**

**AMS Combo**
on the bench, and access to a DGX Spark and GPU workstations for training and

simulation.

**Education**
Useful, not mandatory - CS, Robotics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, AI, Mechanical or

Embedded Systems. We will judge the robot, not the certificate.

**The two seats.**

Both sit in the same stack and both are hands-on. We split them so two people do not solve the same problem twice. In

practice the line will blur.

**Seat 1 Seat 2**

**Perception & Autonomy**
- make the robot see and decide.

Camera and LiDAR pipelines, person and object detection,

tracking, SLAM, localisation, Nav2 planning, obstacle

avoidance, sensor fusion. Leans PyTorch, ONNX, TensorRT,

OpenCV, YOLO, Isaac ROS.

**Integration & Reliability**
- make the robot work.

Jetson-to-microcontroller interfaces, motor and encoder

control, boot and deployment, video streaming, telemetry,

crash recovery. Leans ROS 2 architecture, Docker, ESP32 /

STM32, UART / I2C / CAN, GStreamer, MQTT.

Page 1 · MYSA/HR/2026-27/ROB-111
**MYSA TECHNOLOGY PVT. LTD.**

Regd. Office: 910, Elite Magum, Near Bhuyangdev Cross Roads, Ahmedabad, Gujarat - 380052

CIN: U72900GJ2020PTC113362 · saakh.in · join@saakh.in

**What you'll actually do.**

•
**Own the intelligence layer.**
Someone else may bolt the chassis together and wire the motors. Making the machine

perceive, navigate, decide and respond is yours.

•
**Get models off the laptop and onto the robot.**
PyTorch to ONNX to TensorRT to Jetson to ROS 2 - and the hard part

is the last three steps: latency, GPU memory, FP16 and INT8, thermals, frames you cannot afford to drop.

•
**Build the ROS 2 architecture we will reuse.**
Nodes, packages, launch files, services, actions, TF2, URDF, Nav2. A

platform, not fifteen one-off robots.

•
**Make it boot.**
A robot that needs an engineer to open five terminal windows is a university demonstration. Docker,

auto-start, OTA updates, remote logging, watchdogs, crash recovery.

•
**Simulate before you break things.**
Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab, so the first real-world test is not the first test.

•
**Diagnose the physical world.**
USB disconnects, motor noise resetting a microcontroller, localisation drift, thermal

throttling, a node dying when Wi-Fi drops. This is most of the job on most days, and it is the part we are really hiring

for.

**What we need you to have already.**

**Non-negotiable**
Python. Linux you are genuinely comfortable in, not just a terminal you have seen. Git and GitHub.

Enough networking to debug a connection yourself. The habit of reading a log before asking a

question.

**Several of these**
NVIDIA Jetson · ROS 2 · OpenCV · PyTorch · TensorRT · CUDA · Docker · SLAM · Nav2 ·

LiDAR · stereo or depth cameras · embedded systems. We do not expect all of them - we expect

real use of some.

**Strong advantage**
Isaac ROS, Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, NITROS, DeepStream, GStreamer, WebRTC, OAK-D / DepthAI,

RealSense, ESP32, STM32, FreeRTOS, CAN bus, MQTT, visual or LiDAR SLAM, Kalman

filters, mobile robots, robot arms, drones, reinforcement learning, vision-language-action models.

**What counts as proof**
A repository we can read. A video of the thing moving. A write-up of what broke. College team,

hackathon, personal build, internship - the origin does not matter.

**The questions you should enjoy.**

If this list makes you want to open a terminal, apply. If it makes you tired, please do not - we will both be unhappy by

month two.

• Why is the Jetson dropping camera frames?

• Why does TensorRT inference get slower after ten minutes?

• Why is the robot oscillating while following a person?

• Why is Nav2 refusing to go through a doorway it can clearly fit through?

• Why does motor noise reset the microcontroller?

• Why did a ROS node die when Wi-Fi dropped, and why did nothing restart it?

• Why is the robot seeing itself as an obstacle?

**This is probably not for you if.**

• Your AI experience is calling other people's APIs.

• You have trained models but never deployed one onto constrained hardware.

• Your robotics is coursework and simulation with no physical build behind it.

Page 2 · MYSA/HR/2026-27/ROB-111
**MYSA TECHNOLOGY PVT. LTD.**

Regd. Office: 910, Elite Magum, Near Bhuyangdev Cross Roads, Ahmedabad, Gujarat - 380052

CIN: U72900GJ2020PTC113362 · saakh.in · join@saakh.in

• Your embedded experience stops at following Arduino tutorials.

• You are a mechanical CAD or PCB specialist - both are valuable here, neither is this role.

• You want to work remotely. We have tried to imagine debugging LiDAR drift over a call and we cannot.

**We print our own parts.**

There is a
**Bambu Lab H2D AMS Combo**
in the lab and it is not decoration. We are unreasonably fond of 3D printing

here. When a sensor needs a mount, a LiDAR needs a riser, a camera needs a bracket at one particular angle or a battery

needs a tray, you design it in the afternoon and you are testing it on the robot the same evening. No vendor, no three-week

lead time, no waiting in someone else's CAD queue.

This matters more than it sounds. Most robotics iteration is throttled by how long a physical part takes to arrive. Ours is

throttled by how fast you can think. If you already design your own brackets you will feel at home on day one; if you have

never touched CAD, you will learn, and it will change how fast you work permanently.

**How to apply.**

Write to
**join@saakh.in**
with the subject line:

***Robotics Systems Engineer - [Your Name] - [Seat 1 / Seat 2 / Either]***

Five things in the body. Keep it short - we would rather read a tight email and a long repository than the reverse.

1. Your resume, attached.

2. Your GitHub, and which repository we should actually open.

3. A link to a video of something you built, moving. Phone footage is perfect. A breadboard mess is perfect. We care

that it worked.

4. One paragraph on the hardest bug you have personally fixed in a physical system - what you thought it was, what it

turned out to be, and how you found out.

5. Which seat, which lane, and whether you can be in Ahmedabad.

**What happens next.**
A short call for the basics, then a
**45-minute build round**
with the founder - not a whiteboard, not a

puzzle round, but your actual build and the decisions inside it. Shortlisted candidates get the full role specification first. A

decision follows within 48 hours of the call.

If you have built something real and nobody has looked at it properly yet, this is an invitation to be taken seriously.

For
**Mysa Technology Pvt. Ltd.**

**Arpit Golechha**

Founder & Chief Executive Officer

ag@saakh.in · join@saakh.in

title: Programming + Electronics Mentor
description:
**About the Role**

TIS runs makerspace and innovation programmes inside schools. As a Programming + Electronics Mentor, you will teach and guide students from Grades 1-8 through hands-on learning in coding, electronics, and physical computing. You will run makerspace activities. You will help students move from curiosity to building, tinkering, and problem-solving with real projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Teaching and mentoring**

● Deliver class-appropriate programming and electronics sessions across Grades 1-8 as per curriculum, from unplugged coding and block-based tools in the early grades to text-based coding and microcontroller projects in the upper grades.

● Guide students through circuits, sensors, motors, LEDs, and microcontroller platforms such as Arduino, micro:bit, and ESP32.

● Facilitate project-based, inquiry-driven learning that fits an IB (PYP/MYP) approach.

● Encourage design thinking, debugging, iteration, and reflection in every project.

**Curriculum and content**

● Help implement makerspace curriculum, including lesson plans, project guides, and assessment rubrics.

● Prepare learning materials, demo builds, and student worksheets.

● Contribute ideas for showcase events, exhibitions, and student-led conferences.

**Makerspace operations**

● Maintain tools, components, and kits, and keep inventory records.

● Enforce safety practices for soldering, power tools, batteries, and electronics.

● Keep the lab organised, labelled, and ready for sessions.

**Collaboration and reporting**

● Work closely with school teachers, coordinators, and the TIS team to align sessions with the school calendar.

● Track student progress and share updates and feedback with the Program Manager.

● Document projects with photos, videos, and short write-ups.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

● Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).

● Working knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python, C/C++, or Scratch, and block-based platforms.

● Hands-on experience with Arduino or similar microcontrollers, basic circuit design, and sensors/actuators.

● Ability to explain technical concepts simply to children of different ages.

● Strong classroom management, patience, and communication skills.

● Comfort with troubleshooting hardware and software issues in real time.

**Good to Have**

● Experience teaching or mentoring school students, or running workshops or clubs.

● Familiarity with robotics platforms or competitions.

● Exposure to IB, project-based, or inquiry-led learning.

● Basic knowledge of 3D printing, CAD, or laser cutting.

● Interest in AI/ML concepts for young learners.

What We're Looking For

● A curious, hands-on maker who enjoys learning alongside students

● A patient, energetic communicator who can hold attention across age groups

● A team player who is organised, dependable, and safety-conscious

● Someone who welcomes feedback and keeps improving their teaching

What You'll Gain

● Work in a well-equipped school makerspace, with room to shape programmes as they grow

● Exposure to national robotics competitions and school-industry partnerships

● Mentorship, training, and growth within a young, mission-driven education team

**About Business**

Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

: AGEL is part of the Adani Group’s promise to provide a better, cleaner, and greener future for India. Driven by the Group’s philosophy of Growth with Goodness’, the Company develops, builds, owns, operates, and maintains utility- scale grid-connected solar, wind farm and energy storage (Hydro PSP and Battery) projects. The electricity generated is supplied to central and state government entities and government- backed corporations. On the back of long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) with central and state government entities, AGEL has leveraged its capabilities and expanded its presence across 12 Indian states. With the integration of pump storage and battery storage projects with large solar & wind portfolio, AGEL shall be best placed amongst peers to supply round-the-clock green power to India’s grid. The Company continuously adopts and deploys the latest technologies in its projects. With the target of 50 GW renewable energy capacity by 2030, AGEL is driving India on its renewable energy journey.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
Lead - Integrated Management System (IMS) is responsible for the strategic development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of the Integrated Management System. This role ensures that IMS effectively integrates various management standards and frameworks, such as quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety systems. The Lead will focus on ensuring comprehensive compliance with industry standards, optimizing system performance, and driving operational efficiency through regular audits, process improvements, and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**IMS Framework Design and Integration:**
Design and integrate a comprehensive Integrated Management System (IMS) that aligns with ISO standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and organizational objectives.
  
  
Ensure the IMS framework integrates quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety management systems into a cohesive structure that enhances operational efficiency and regulatory compliance, leverage industry best practices and technological advancements to create a robust and scalable IMS.
  
  
**System Architecture And Process Optimization**
Develop and refine the architecture of the IMS to support seamless integration across various management systems.
  
  
Focus on process optimization by implementing advanced methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Management (BPM), utilize process mapping and simulation tools to identify inefficiencies and enhance process performance, ensuring that the IMS supports continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  
  
**Risk Management And Compliance Integration**
Integrate comprehensive risk management practices within the IMS to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks.
  
  
Implement advanced risk assessment tools and techniques, including probabilistic risk analysis and scenario planning, to ensure robust risk management, ensure that the IMS supports compliance with local, national, and international regulations by embedding compliance checks and controls within the system.
  
  
**Performance Monitoring And Data Analytics**
Establish advanced performance monitoring mechanisms using data analytics and real-time dashboards.
  
  
Implement Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of the IMS and its impact on organizational performance, utilize data analytics platforms and business intelligence tools to analyze performance trends, identify areas for improvement, and drive data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**Audit And Assurance Processes**
Develop and manage rigorous internal and external audit processes to ensure the integrity and effectiveness of the IMS, implement automated audit management systems to streamline audit processes, track findings, and ensure timely corrective actions.
  
  
Coordinate with certification bodies and regulatory agencies to maintain compliance and certification status.
  
  
**Technology Integration And System Upgrades**
Lead the integration of advanced technologies and digital solutions within the IMS to enhance system functionality and efficiency.
  
  
Explore and implement emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), and blockchain to improve data accuracy, process automation, and system interoperability, plan and execute system upgrades to ensure the IMS remains current with technological advancements and industry standards.

Senior Leadership Team
  
  
Department SPOCs
  
  
Operations Team
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
External Auditors
  
  
Industry Certification Bodies
  
  
Regulatory Agencies
  
  
Consultants
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualifications:**

description:
Thin Film Process Engineer Semiconductor Wafer Fabrication

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India

Onsite

**Experience:**
6 -15 Years

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced
**Thin Film Process Engineer**
to develop, optimize, qualify, and sustain thin film deposition processes within an advanced semiconductor wafer fabrication facility. This role is responsible for establishing stable deposition processes for dielectric, conductive, barrier, and semiconductor films that meet stringent electrical, physical, and reliability requirements while enabling high-volume semiconductor manufacturing.

The successful candidate will collaborate with Process Integration, Lithography, Etch, CMP, Diffusion, Ion Implant, Yield Engineering, Equipment Engineering, Manufacturing, Metrology, and Quality teams to optimize thin film processes, improve yield, qualify new materials, and support technology ramp-up.

Candidates should possess strong expertise in CVD, PECVD, LPCVD, ALD, PVD, sputtering, epitaxy, film characterization, stress control, and Statistical Process Control (SPC).

Role Objectives

* Develop world-class thin film deposition processes.
* Achieve excellent film uniformity, composition, thickness, and electrical performance.
* Improve manufacturing yield through process optimization.
* Support technology transfer and high-volume manufacturing.
* Deliver repeatable, scalable, and robust deposition processes.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, optimize, and sustain thin film deposition processes for advanced semiconductor manufacturing.
* Establish process windows for dielectric, metal, barrier, and semiconductor film deposition.
* Optimize deposition recipes for film thickness, uniformity, stress, step coverage, conformality, resistivity, and adhesion.
* Develop and qualify CVD, PECVD, LPCVD, ALD, PVD, sputtering, and epitaxial growth processes.
* Evaluate new precursor chemistries, process gases, deposition materials, and consumables.
* Perform Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize film characteristics and process capability.
* Analyze metrology, electrical test, and yield data to identify process improvement opportunities.
* Drive continuous reduction of particles, film defects, voids, delamination, contamination, and non-uniformity.
* Collaborate with Etch, CMP, Lithography, Diffusion, and Process Integration teams to optimize overall process flow.
* Support installation, qualification, and acceptance of new deposition equipment.
* Develop engineering specifications, process documentation, qualification reports, and standard operating procedures.
* Utilize Statistical Process Control (SPC) to monitor process health and stability.
* Support Advanced Process Control (APC) implementation for improved manufacturing consistency.
* Participate in technology transfer and New Product Introduction (NPI) activities.
* Perform root cause analysis for process excursions and yield losses.
* Improve throughput, productivity, and manufacturing efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with semiconductor quality systems, cleanroom protocols, and EHS standards.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities During Fab Startup

* Support installation and qualification of thin film deposition tools.
* Develop baseline deposition recipes for manufacturing.
* Establish process qualification methodologies.
* Define process specifications and control plans.
* Qualify deposition materials, precursors, and process gases.
* Support engineering builds, pilot production, and technology transfer.
* Develop manufacturing SOPs and engineering documentation.
* Train production personnel on deposition processes.
* Improve process capability before production ramp.
* Support high-volume manufacturing readiness.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, or related discipline.

* Strong expertise in thin film deposition technologies.
* Experience supporting advanced semiconductor manufacturing.

title: Lead Generation Executive
description:
WE’RE HIRING: LEAD GENERATION EXECUTIVE (
TELECALLING & APPOINTMENT SETTING/
INSIDE SALES)

📍 Gota, Ahmedabad | Full-time | Work from Office

💼 Experience: 0–3 years

💰 Salary: ₹25,000–₹30,000 per month + performance incentives

About Gracia Marcom

Gracia Marcom is a purpose-driven advertising, marketing and business-growth company helping brands establish, market and scale their presence across India and international markets—particularly the USA.

Our services include branding, digital marketing, websites, e-commerce, content, events, print production, marketing automation and international market activation.

We are building a disciplined, ambitious and people-centred team where individuals receive the freedom to take ownership, the challenges to develop competence and the support to grow professionally and personally.

**Why Are We Hiring for This Position?**

We are looking for a confident and persistent Telecalling & Appointment Setting Executive who can start meaningful conversations with prospective clients, understand their business needs and schedule qualified appointments for our business-development team.

This is not a position where you simply read from a script or make random calls to complete a daily target.

You will represent Gracia Marcom during the first interaction with potential clients. Your ability to create curiosity, listen carefully and build trust will directly influence our business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Make outbound calls to prospective clients in India and international markets.
* Contact leads through phone calls, WhatsApp, email and LinkedIn.
* Introduce Gracia Marcom’s services clearly and confidently.
* Understand each prospect’s business, challenges and marketing priorities.
* Qualify leads based on their requirements, decision-making authority, budget, interest and timeline.
* Schedule qualified meetings for the business-development or leadership team.
* Follow up consistently with interested prospects without becoming repetitive or pushy.
* Handle initial questions and objections professionally.
* Maintain accurate lead information, call notes, follow-up dates and appointment status in the CRM or tracking sheet.
* Confirm scheduled appointments and reduce meeting cancellations and no-shows.
* Re-engage inactive, old and previously interested leads.
* Coordinate with the marketing and business-development teams on campaigns and lead quality.
* Share regular reports on calls, conversations, follow-ups, appointments and outcomes.
* Learn from call results and continuously improve the pitch, questions and follow-up approach.
* Achieve agreed targets for qualified conversations and confirmed appointments.

**What Does the Right Person Look Like?**

You may be a strong fit if you:

* Communicate clearly and confidently in English and Hindi.
* Are comfortable speaking with founders, business owners and senior decision-makers.
* Can listen carefully instead of dominating the conversation.
* Know how to ask relevant questions and understand a prospect’s actual requirements.
* Can build rapport without sounding scripted or overly sales-focused.
* Are comfortable making outbound calls and following up consistently.
* Can handle rejection without losing confidence or professionalism.
* Are organised and disciplined about updating lead records and follow-up dates.
* Take responsibility for results rather than only reporting the number of calls made.
* Are curious about business, marketing and international growth.
* Can learn different services and explain their value in simple language.

Freshers with excellent communication skills, confidence and a strong willingness to learn may also apply.

Experience in telecalling, telesales, appointment setting, inside sales, lead generation, customer service or business development will be preferred.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

Success is not measured only by how many calls you make. It is measured by:

* Meaningful conversations with relevant prospects.
* Correctly qualified leads.
* Confirmed appointments with decision-makers.
* Strong attendance rates for scheduled meetings.
* Consistent and timely follow-ups.
* Accurate lead and CRM records.
* Improvement in appointment quality and conversion over time.

**Our Value System**

*Disciplined Execution*

You follow up when promised, maintain accurate records, and consistently turn daily plans into reliable action.

*Empowered Autonomy*

You receive the freedom to manage conversations and follow-ups while remaining accountable for appointment quality and results.

*Growth Through Challenge*

Every objection, difficult prospect, and unsuccessful call becomes an opportunity to strengthen your communication and sales ability.

*Purposeful Alignment*

Your work should create value for the prospective client, contribute to Gracia Marcom’s growth and support your own professional development.

*Co-creation of an Ecosystem for Deeper Interests*

We encourage you to contribute ideas, improve scripts and processes, explore your strengths and grow beyond a narrowly defined calling role.

We also believe in open conversations, empathetic leadership, psychological safety, and employee wellbeing. High performance and a supportive workplace should coexist.

**Where Can This Position Lead?**

A strong performer can grow into roles such as:

* Senior Appointment Setter
* Inside Sales Executive
* Business Development Executive
* International Business Development Executive
* Inside Sales Team Leader
* Business Development Manager

Your growth will depend on the quality of your conversations, appointments, and follow-ups.

**Company Size & Vibe Check**

We are a growing, hands-on team where your contribution will be visible and meaningful.

You will work closely with decision-makers, receive direct feedback, and understand how your conversations influence actual business opportunities. Our environment is ambitious, collaborative, execution-focused, and built for people who want to take responsibility and grow.

**Please Do Not Apply If**

* You are uncomfortable making outbound calls.
* You believe telecalling means reading the same script to every prospect.
* You focus only on call quantity and take no responsibility for lead or appointment quality.
* You avoid follow-ups after the first call or message.
* You become discouraged by rejection or unanswered calls.
* You are uncomfortable speaking in professional English.
* You do not listen carefully or record conversation details accurately.
* You require repeated reminders to complete routine follow-ups.
* You are unwilling to learn about marketing, business and Gracia Marcom’s services.
* You are uncomfortable working toward measurable targets.
* You are not comfortable commuting to our office in Gota, Ahmedabad, for a full-time, work-from-office role.
* You are unwilling to work during market-relevant hours when handling international prospects.
* You are looking only for a temporary calling job rather than an opportunity to build a career in sales and business development.

**Work Arrangement**

This is a full-time, work-from-office position at Gota, Ahmedabad.

Depending on the assigned target market, candidates should be open to working during suitable business hours for Indian or international prospects. The applicable work timings will be communicated clearly.

**How to Apply**

Send your updated résumé along with brief answers to the following questions:

1. How much experience do you have in telecalling, telesales, appointment setting or inside sales?
2. Which industries, products, or services have you previously called prospects for?
3. Approximately how many outbound calls did you make per day?
4. How many qualified appointments did you schedule in an average week or month?
5. How would you respond if a prospect said, “I’m interested, but send me the details first”?
6. Are you comfortable communicating professionally in English and Hindi?
7. Are you comfortable commuting to our office in Gota, Ahmedabad, for a full-time, work-from-office role?
8. What are your current salary, expected salary, and earliest joining date?

Apply if you enjoy starting conversations, understanding people, and turning initial interest into genuine business meetings.

title: AR Caller
description:
Medical Billing Voice Associate

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, India

**Work Arrangement:**
On-site (US shift)

**Shift Time:**
5:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, Permanent

**Experience:**
Freshers to 1+ year in voice-based processes

About Our Client

Our client is a leading healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) organization with over two decades of industry expertise. The company specializes in medical and dental billing solutions, helping healthcare providers maximize revenue and reduce operating costs through a combination of technology, automation, and skilled teams.

With a global workforce of 4,000+ professionals and operations spanning 12 locations across the United States and India, the organization serves thousands of healthcare providers across more than 50 medical specialties. Their teams handle everything from claims processing and insurance verification to denial management and end-to-end revenue cycle support.

This is an opportunity to join a structured, process-driven environment where freshers receive training and professionals build long-term careers in healthcare RCM operations.

About the Role

As a Medical Billing Voice Associate, you will serve as the frontline communicator between healthcare providers and insurance companies. Your primary focus will be on outbound calls to insurance carriers to verify patient eligibility, obtain claim status, and follow up on unpaid or denied claims.

This role is ideal for individuals who are comfortable with high-volume voice-based work, can maintain accuracy under deadlines, and thrive in a collaborative night-shift environment. You will work on live accounts receivable reports, document every interaction, and ensure that claims are processed and resolved efficiently.

Successful candidates will have strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to navigate multiple systems while maintaining compliance with client-specific guidelines and information security standards.

Key Responsibilities

* Make outbound calls to insurance companies to verify patient eligibility and obtain claim status
* Follow up on unpaid, denied, or outstanding claims based on reports received from clients or generated through client software
* Document denial details and initiate appropriate follow-up actions
* Work through account receivable reports and outstanding claims reports assigned by the team lead
* Complete assigned targets with speed and accuracy in line with client SLAs
* Maintain individual daily logs of calls, outcomes, and follow-up actions
* Collaborate with team members to achieve shared operational goals
* Escalate communication or process issues to seniors in a timely manner
* Adhere to information security policies, client/project guidelines, business rules, and quality standards
* Work across any voice-based process as required (insurance follow-up, patient calling, provider outreach, etc.)

Required Qualifications

* Any undergraduate or graduate degree
* Freshers with strong communication skills are encouraged to apply
* 1+ year of experience in voice-based processes preferred
* Willingness to work in night shifts (8:00 PM – 5:00 AM IST or 5:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST)
* Comfortable with outbound calling and high-volume voice work
* Basic computer proficiency and ability to learn client-specific software

Technical Skills

**Communication:**
Clear spoken English; confident phone presence

**Systems:**
Ability to navigate multiple software platforms and maintain digital logs

**Domain (trainable):**
Insurance verification, claim status follow-up, denial documentation, account receivable reporting

**Compliance:**
Understanding of information security and confidentiality requirements

What You Will Bring

* A customer-focused approach to every call
* Strong attention to detail when documenting claim information
* Ability to stay organized while handling multiple claims and follow-ups
* Willingness to learn healthcare RCM processes and insurance terminology
* Team-oriented mindset and reliability in meeting daily targets
* Comfort with repetitive voice-based tasks in a structured, SLA-driven environment

Why This Opportunity

* **Structured entry point**
  into healthcare revenue cycle management—a growing industry with long-term career potential
* **Training provided**
  for freshers to build confidence in insurance follow-up processes
* **Night-shift differential**
  and competitive compensation
* **Global organization**
  with operations in the US and India
* **Collaborative team environment**
  with support from experienced seniors
* **Clear targets and processes**
  —you will know exactly what success looks like

title: Senior Staff Specialist IT - Windchill
description:

* Develop custom APIs using Windchill's Java-based API, to integrate with other systems, services, or applications, ensuring seamless data exchange and functionality.
* Implement business logic, workflows, and rules using Windchill's Java-based scripting engine, to automate and streamline product development, manufacturing, and quality processes.
* Ensure high-quality code, following best practices, coding standards, and Windchill's development guidelines, to maintain scalability, performance, and maintainability.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, project managers, and other developers, to ensure successful project delivery and effective communication.

Your Profile
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

title: Civil Site Engineers - Field Operations (Freshers Can Apply)
description:
**Company Description**

Inkers Technology is based in Bengaluru with offices in USA and UAE. We specialise in designing and developing deep large-scale AI and ML solutions for the Construction Industry. With a focus on AI, computer vision, and deep neural networks, we have extended our capabilities into the construction industry with our innovative AI-powered construction management solution, “Kael” — an AI project manager that predicts delays, flags risks, automates reporting, and prevents cost overruns with real-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform, “Observance”, uses LiDAR scanning, thermal imaging, and AI-powered analysis to deliver BIM Models, deviation detection, and as-built intelligence. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of technology across diverse sectors.

**About the Role**

We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated Civil Engineering graduates who are willing to learn and build their careers in Construction Technology. The role involves visiting construction sites, capturing site data using 3D scanning equipment, coordinating with on-site teams, and uploading the collected data to the designated platform. The candidate should have good communication skills, take ownership of assigned tasks, and ensure timely completion of work.

**Responsibilities**

* Visit construction sites and perform 3D scanning of designated construction areas.
* Capture site data and ensure all required scans and information are collected accurately.
* Upload scanned files, site photographs, and other relevant information to the designated platform.
* Coordinate with site engineers, supervisors, contractors, and labourers to complete scanning activities.
* Communicate with on-site labourers and explain the requirements to ensure smooth execution of assigned activities.
* Collect and share relevant site inputs, observations, and updates with the internal team.
* Ensure all assigned site activities are completed within the given timelines.
* Follow the scanning process and guidelines provided by the technical team.
* Identify and report any site-related challenges or discrepancies to the reporting manager.
* Maintain proper records of site visits, scanned data, and daily work updates.

**Skillsets**

**Required Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering (B.E./B.Tech).
* Fresh graduates with 0–1 years of experience are encouraged to apply.
* Graduates from reputed/top Civil Engineering colleges preferred.
* Good communication skills in Hindi and the local language (Gujarati).
* Basic understanding of construction activities and site operations.
* Willingness to work at construction sites and interact with labourers and site teams.
* Basic computer knowledge and ability to upload and manage files.
* Strong willingness to learn new technologies and processes.
* Good coordination, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to take ownership of assigned responsibilities and complete tasks on time.
* Positive attitude, attention to detail, and willingness to learn and grow.

**Good to Have**

* Internship or academic project experience involving construction sites.
* Basic knowledge of AutoCAD or other civil engineering tools.
* Familiarity with 3D scanning, LiDAR, or construction technology (not mandatory).

**Work Location:**
Ahmedabad (On-site)

**Work Week :**
Monday to Saturday

title: Lead Master Planner
description:
**Responsibilities**
**Purpose:**
The Lead Master Planner at City Side Developments, Adani Airport Holdings Ltd, will play a pivotal role in the design and development of Master planning and Urban design projects. The candidate will work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team of Masterplanners, Architects, engineers, and project managers to create innovative and functional designs that meet the needs business needs and the highest standards of quality. Expertise in Urban design, design management, and stakeholder management is essential.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**
Lead the master planning for a large-scale mixed use development, encompassing commercial, hospitality, offices, convention centers, etc.
  
  

* Develop site layouts, urban design guidelines, transportation plans, and landscaping strategies that respond to site constraints, zoning codes, environmental conditions, and project goals.
* Lead the design development of the master plan through all stages, including feasibility analysis, data collection, design brief preparation, iterative concept development, and technical documentation, ensuring adherence to design standards, budgets, and timelines.
* Collaborate with external consultant and Internal project teams to develop detailed master plans, drawings, and specifications.
* Utilize demographic, economic, and geographic data to inform planning decisions and strategies.
* Develop comprehensive urban design strategies, master plans, and zoning guidelines that enhance the functionality, sustainability, and livability of urban spaces.
* Assess land use patterns, zoning regulations, and policy frameworks to guide development.
* Integrate transportation solutions, transit-oriented development, and multi-modal transportation systems into planning efforts.
* Contribute to the development of planning policies, guidelines, and regulations.
* Develop innovative and sustainable urban design solutions that enhance the functionality, aesthetics, and livability of urban areas.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior designers, fostering their professional growth and development.
* Conduct urban research and analysis to inform design decisions, incorporating best practices, emerging trends, and sustainable design principles.
* Prepare and present strategy documents, masterplan reports, and visualizations to internal and external stakeholders, including investors and statutory bodies
* Incorporate sustainable design principles and environmental considerations into master plans.
* Ensure that urban design projects comply with zoning regulations, local codes, and planning guidelines.

**Experience**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 15–18 years as a Master planner/Urban Designer, with significant work on large-scale mixed use real estate projects.
* Proven track record in leading full-cycle projects from concept development to on-site completion.

**Education Qualification**

* Bachelor of Architecture from a recognized institution.
* Preferred: M. Arch from reputed institutes such as CEPT University and School of Planning & Architecture (SPA).

**Certification Required**
No specific certifications required, but relevant certifications in architectural design are advantageous.
  
  
**Behavioural Skills**

* Exceptional leadership and communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Ability to thrive in a collaborative, deadline-driven environment.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency with AutoCAD, Sketch Up, MS office and know how of Revit, GIS would be essential.
* Proficiency in building/planning, infra codes for Urban design, planning and building.
* Experience in preparing design brief and feasibility studies.

**Non-Negotiable Skills**

* Expertise in master planning, urban design, infrastructure coordination, transportation, landscaping, and sustainable development
* Must have exhibited design and design coordination skills with various design stakeholders like landscape, traffic, infra (including PHE, Electrical etc.) and SMEP
* Demonstrable workplace experience of survey and analysis of sites, preparation of base plans and supporting material required for urban design and master planning work is essential.
* At least one full cycle of experience from concept development to on-site completion

**Conclusion**
The Lead Master Planner role at Adani presents an exciting opportunity for an experienced professional to lead transformative design initiatives in the real estate and hospitality industry. If you are passionate about creating innovative and sustainable architectural solutions and possess the requisite skills and qualifications, we encourage you to apply and become a valuable contributor to our dynamic team.

title: Server Patch & Vulnerability Remediation Engineer
description:
**Role Description**
**Position Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Server Patch \& Vulnerability Remediation Engineer to join our centralized Patch Management team.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, prioritizing, and remediating security vulnerabilities across Windows and Unix server environments. This role requires strong operating system administration skills, hands\-on experience with vulnerability remediation, knowledge of third\-party and open\-source software vulnerabilities, and the ability to develop, test, and deploy automated remediation solutions.
   

  

 The engineer will work closely with application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, and software vendors to ensure vulnerabilities are addressed within established remediation timelines while maintaining system stability, availability, and compliance with organizational security standards. Key Responsibilities
 **Required Qualifications** 
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Windows and Unix Operating System Administration
* Strong hands\-on experience administering Windows Server and Unix/Linux operating systems.
* Knowledge of Group Policy Objects (GPOs), shared file systems, user and access management, software installation, configuration, and system administration.
* Ability to troubleshoot operating system, application, and patch installation issues.
* Understanding of server dependencies, system services, permissions, and configurations that may affect patch deployment and remediation.
* Experience supporting enterprise server environments and performing security updates with minimal operational disruption.
* Vulnerability Analysis and Third\-Party Software Remediation
* Experience investigating vulnerabilities identified through Software Composition Analysis (SCA), software scanning, and vulnerability assessment tools.
* Ability to analyze vulnerability findings affecting operating systems, third\-party applications, open\-source components, and installed software.
* Knowledge of software installation paths, package dependencies, vulnerable libraries, application versions, and other factors required to determine the root cause of vulnerabilities.
* Ability to identify appropriate remediation options, including vendor patches, software upgrades, configuration changes, component replacement, or removal of vulnerable software.
* Experience coordinating with software vendors, opening support cases, reviewing release notes, validating remediation recommendations, and implementing tested solutions.
* Ability to develop remediation plans and coordinate with application and infrastructure owners to complete remediation within SLAs.
* Scripting, Automation, and BigFix
* Proficiency in scripting and automation using PowerShell, shell scripting, and other relevant automation technologies.
* Hands\-on experience with BigFix or similar enterprise patch management platforms.
* Ability to develop, test, and maintain automation scripts for vulnerability remediation, patch deployment, software upgrades, and compliance validation.
* Experience automating repetitive operational activities to improve remediation efficiency, consistency, and scalability.
* Ability to troubleshoot failed deployments and automate post\-remediation verification wherever feasible.
* Application Packaging and Software Deployment
* Knowledge of application packaging, software installation, configuration, and deployment processes is a plus.
* Experience preparing, testing, and deploying third\-party and open\-source software updates across enterprise server environments.
* Ability to analyze application installation requirements, dependencies, compatibility considerations, and potential operational impacts.
* Understanding of software versioning, package management, installation parameters, and silent installation techniques.
* Experience with BigFix or similar tools for software distribution and deployment is desirable.
* Vulnerability Remediation, Change Management, and Troubleshooting
* Experience executing security patching and vulnerability remediation activities across enterprise server environments.
* Ability to prioritize remediation based on vulnerability severity, exploitability, asset criticality, and organizational remediation timelines.
* Knowledge of change management processes, maintenance windows, implementation plans, rollback procedures, and post\-deployment validation.
* Ability to investigate failed patches, installation errors, application compatibility issues, and other remediation blockers.
* Experience coordinating with application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, and other stakeholders to resolve remediation challenges.
* Ability to maintain accurate remediation records, provide status updates, and support security compliance and audit reporting.
* Analyze vulnerability and software scanning findings affecting Windows and Unix/Linux servers.
* Investigate reported vulnerabilities to determine the affected software, installation locations, vulnerable components, and appropriate remediation approach.
* Develop and execute remediation plans for operating system, third\-party, and open\-source software vulnerabilities.
* Identify applicable vendor fixes, security updates, software upgrades, and alternative treatment options.
* Coordinate with software vendors and application owners to obtain remediation guidance and resolve technical dependencies.
* Test patches and software updates in non\-production environments, validate results, and coordinate production deployment through approved change management processes.
* Develop and maintain PowerShell, shell, and BigFix automation to improve patch deployment and vulnerability remediation efficiency.
* Troubleshoot patch failures, software installation issues, compatibility problems, and post\-deployment incidents.
* Perform post\-remediation validation to confirm that vulnerabilities have been addressed and systems remain operational.
* Track remediation progress, maintain evidence, document exceptions and blockers, and provide accurate status updates to management and security stakeholders.
* Partner with infrastructure, application, security, and operations teams to meet remediation SLAs and maintain compliance with organizational security requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve patching processes, automation, deployment reliability, and overall vulnerability remediation effectiveness.
* Relevant experience in Windows and Unix/Linux server administration, enterprise patch management, vulnerability remediation, or infrastructure operations.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working in a large enterprise IT environment with established change management and security compliance requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across technical teams and application stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple remediation activities and meet defined deadlines in a fast\-paced operational environment.
* Hands\-on experience with BigFix for patch management, software deployment, and automation.
* Experience with vulnerability assessment and Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tools such as Qualys or equivalent platforms.
* Knowledge of security advisories, CVEs, vulnerable software components, and vendor remediation guidance.
* Experience with application packaging and third\-party software lifecycle management.
* Familiarity with enterprise vulnerability management processes, remediation SLAs, and security compliance requirements.


**Skills**
 UNIX, BigFix, Patch Management, Vulnerability Management

title: Performance Marketer
description:
**Performance Marketer – Meta Ads \& Webinar Funnels** 

**Location:** 

 Ahmedabad / Hybrid
 




**Experience:** 

 2–3\+ years
 




**Employment:** 

 Full\-time
 




**CTC:** 

 ₹5–6 LPA \+ Performance Incentives
 




*Higher compensation can be considered for exceptional candidates with strong campaign ownership and funnel\-building capabilities.* 



**About the Role** 


 We’re looking for a
 
**Senior Performance Marketer who can take ownership of Meta Ads and webinar funnels — not just operate Ads Manager.** 





 You’ll be responsible for planning, launching, optimizing and scaling paid campaigns while understanding the
 
**entire journey from ad → landing page → registration → webinar attendance → conversion.** 





 We need someone who can look beyond CPL and ask:
 




**Are we attracting the right leads? Are they registering? Are they showing up? Are they converting? And what needs to change to improve those numbers?** 





 This is a hands\-on role for someone who is analytical, commercially aware, comfortable experimenting, and capable of independently identifying what is and isn’t working.
 





 You should also be comfortable using
 
**AI tools such as Claude to create and iterate landing pages** 

 , rather than being dependent on a developer for every funnel change.
 



**What You’ll Own** 
**1\. Meta Ads \& Campaign Performance** 
* Independently plan, launch, manage and optimize
 
**Meta Ads campaigns**
* Manage lead generation and webinar registration campaigns across multiple accounts
* Monitor and improve key metrics including:
* CPL
* CTR
* CPC
* CPM
* Landing Page Conversion Rate
* Cost per Webinar Registration
* Lead Quality
* Diagnose performance drops and identify whether the issue lies with the
 
**creative, audience, offer, landing page or campaign structure**
* Build structured testing plans instead of making random campaign changes
* Identify winning campaigns, audiences and creatives and scale them intelligently
* Maintain strong daily campaign hygiene across accounts


**2\. Funnel \& Landing Page Optimization** 


 You will not be evaluated only on Ads Manager numbers.
 





 You should understand how the
 
**complete funnel affects paid media performance.** 





 You’ll be expected to:
 



* Analyze landing\-page conversion and opt\-in rates
* Identify friction or drop\-offs in webinar registration funnels
* Recommend and implement landing\-page improvements
* **Build and modify landing pages using AI tools such as Claude and similar AI\-assisted tools**
* Test headlines, sections, CTAs, layouts and offers to improve conversion rates
* Understand the impact of reminder sequences and follow\-ups on webinar show\-up rates
* Work comfortably with funnel tools such as
 
**GHL, ClickFunnels or similar platforms**




 Prior coding expertise is
 
**not mandatory** 

 , but you should be comfortable using AI to build and troubleshoot functional landing pages.
 



**3\. Creative Strategy** 


 We don't want a media buyer who simply waits for the creative team to send the next ad.
 





 You should be able to:
 



* Identify why certain creatives are winning or losing
* Analyze hooks, messaging, formats and audience resonance
* Spot creative fatigue early
* Recommend new creative angles based on campaign data
* Create structured briefs for the copy and design teams
* Run systematic tests across:
* Hooks
* Angles
* Formats
* Offers
* Audiences
* Translate campaign data into actionable feedback for the creative team


**4\. Tracking \& Analytics** 


 You should have working knowledge of:
 



* Meta Pixel
* Events and conversion tracking
* Meta Ads Manager reporting
* UTM parameters
* Google Analytics




 Knowledge of the following is strongly preferred:
 



* Google Tag Manager (GTM)
* Meta Conversion API (CAPI)
* Funnel/event tracking




 You don't need to be a tracking engineer, but you
 
**must be able to recognize when the data cannot be trusted and investigate why.** 



**5\. Budget Management \& Scaling** 


 You’ll be expected to:
 



* Manage campaign budgets responsibly across multiple accounts
* Make informed budget allocation decisions
* Know when to scale, hold, reduce or kill campaigns
* Scale winning campaigns without unnecessarily destabilizing performance
* Reallocate spend based on performance and business objectives
* Communicate clearly when additional budget is — or isn't — justified


**Who We're Looking For** 
**Must\-Haves** 
* **2–3\+ years of hands\-on performance marketing experience**
* Strong practical experience with
 
**Meta Ads**
* Experience managing lead\-generation campaigns
* Experience handling campaigns independently — not just assisting another media buyer
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Understanding of landing\-page conversion and funnel performance
* Ability to use
 
**AI tools such as Claude to create/modify landing pages**
* Ability to interpret campaign data and decide what action to take next
* Strong ownership and attention to detail
* Comfortable working across multiple client accounts


**Strong Advantage If You Have** 
* Experience running
 
**webinar funnels**
* Experience marketing coaching, consulting, education or other high\-ticket offers
* Experience with GHL / ClickFunnels or similar funnel builders
* GTM/CAPI implementation knowledge
* Experience managing substantial monthly Meta Ads budgets
* Experience improving not just CPL but
 
**lead quality and downstream conversion**
* Experience working in a fast\-moving agency environment


**What We DON'T Want** 


 This role may not be the right fit if you:
 



* Need someone to tell you what optimization to make every day
* Judge campaign success purely by CPL
* Only know how to boost posts or run basic lead\-generation campaigns
* Cannot explain
 
*why* 

 campaign performance changed
* Wait for the creative team instead of proactively suggesting new tests
* Have never independently managed campaigns
* Are uncomfortable learning and working with AI tools
* Prefer executing instructions over taking ownership of outcomes


**What Success Looks Like** 


 Within your first 90 days, we expect you to be able to:
 



* Independently own assigned Meta Ads accounts
* Maintain clean campaign structures and tracking
* Consistently identify performance issues and propose solutions
* Develop clear testing plans for creatives, audiences and funnels
* Improve or stabilize acquisition costs without compromising lead quality
* Identify landing\-page bottlenecks and implement improvements
* Build/modify landing pages using AI tools when required
* Provide useful creative insights based on campaign data
* Clearly communicate
 
**what happened, why it happened and what you're doing next**




 Ultimately, success isn't:
 




**“I got the CPL down.”** 





 It's:
 




**“I understand what is driving business results, and I know what we should test next to improve them.”** 



**How to Apply** 


 Please apply with:
 



1. Your CV / LinkedIn profile
2. Total years of hands\-on Meta Ads experience
3. Approximate
 
**monthly ad spend personally managed**
4. 2–3 examples of campaigns you've personally managed, including:


* Objective
* Budget
* CPL/CPA
* What wasn't working
* What you changed
* Result


1. Experience with webinar or lead\-generation funnels
2. Landing\-page/funnel tools you've worked with
3. AI tools you've used for landing\-page creation
4. Current CTC
5. Expected CTC
6. Notice period / earliest joining date



**Important:** 

 Please don't send only screenshots of ROAS/CPL. We want to understand
 
**what decisions you personally made that improved the campaign.** 



**Compensation** 

**₹5–6 LPA \+ performance\-linked incentives** 





 Compensation will depend on your ability to independently own campaigns, manage budgets, understand funnels and tracking, contribute to creative strategy, and build/iterate landing pages using AI.
 





 Exceptional candidates demonstrating strong ownership across the complete acquisition funnel may be considered above this range.

title: QA
description:
Job Title: QA Executive Location: Nava Wadaj, Ahmedabad, India Company: STORE TRANSFORM About STORE TRANSFORMSTORE TRANSFORM is a leading and growing IT company specializing in end‑to‑end digital solutions for modern businesses. With a strong focus on eCommerce, WordPress, Magento, and Shopify ecosystems, we design, develop, optimize, and market high‑performance online platforms that help brands scale quickly and efficiently. We provide AI‑powered IT solutions, web development, design, and digital marketing services all under one roof, enabling clients to avoid juggling multiple agencies and instead work with a single, integrated technology partner.
   

  

 Role SummaryWe are seeking an experienced QA Executive with professional experience in testing websites, web applications, and mobile apps. The candidate must have a strong understanding of functional and UI/UX testing, with hands\-on experience in platforms such as WordPress, Magento, Shopify, and mobile apps (iOS/Android). The role demands excellent attention to detail, clear communication skills, and a structured, process‑oriented approach to testing.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities Test Planning \& Execution Prepare and execute detailed test cases based on project requirements and user stories. Perform functional, UI/UX, regression, cross‑browser, and cross‑device testing for web and mobile platforms. Conduct sanity and smoke testing before deployments to ensure core functionality is stable.
   

  

 Bug Reporting \& Validation Report bugs and issues using QA tools such as Jira, Trello, or ClickUp, including clear steps, screenshots, and environment details. Verify fixes in follow‑up testing cycles and ensure defects are properly closed. Maintain a structured approach to re‑testing, regression suites, and release sign‑off.
   

  

 Website \& eCommerce Testing Test websites built on WordPress, Magento, Shopify, and custom frameworks, validating both frontend and backend behavior. Validate responsive layouts, mobile browser compatibility, and device‑specific behavior for all major devices and browsers. Test core flows such as navigation, forms, checkout, user accounts, and multi‑step processes.
   

  

 Mobile App Testing Conduct Android and iOS app testing using real devices as well and emulators/simulators. Test application installation, login flows, in‑app navigation, push notifications, and background processes. Verify API responses, offline behavior, crash reporting, and performance across different network conditions.
   

  

 Collaboration \& Documentation Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and UX designers to improve quality and user experience. Document test plans, test execution logs, QA sign‑off reports, and release summaries. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and align testing activities with sprint timelines and release goals.
   

  

 Required Skills \& Qualifications3–4 years of professional QA experience in testing websites, web applications, and mobile apps. Strong proficiency in writing test cases, bug reports, and QA documentation. Familiarity with bug tracking and project management tools such as Jira, Trello, or ClickUp.
   

  

 Hands‑on experience in cross‑browser and responsive testing across desktop and mobile browsers. Strong understanding of browser developer tools (Inspect Element, Console, Network tab, etc.). Basic knowledge of Agile/Scrum workflows and involvement in sprint‑based QA cycles.

 Dynamic Dreamz is a Shopify Platinum Partner specializing in helping DTC brands, B2B businesses, enterprise ecommerce teams, and digital agencies build, migrate, and scale on Shopify and Shopify Plus. Established in 2006, the agency brings over 20 years of ecommerce and technology experience through a team of 150\+ professionals. title: Chief Human Resources Officer
description:
**Position:** 
 Group Chief Human Resources Officer (Group CHRO)
 



**Company:** 
 Confidential (A diversified multinational conglomerate spanning manufacturing, consumer business, and financial services)
 



**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad (Work from Office — 5 days a week, no hybrid) with regular travel to plants and retail stores
 



**Experience:** 
 18–25 years in HR, with at least 7 years as CHRO or Group HR Head of a multi\-business group spanning manufacturing plants and a consumer or retail business
 



**Qualification:** 
 MBA / PGDM in HR or Personnel Management from a reputed institute preferred
 



  





**Background Sought:** 
 Must bring Group/multi\-business CHRO experience \+ manufacturing plant HR \& industrial relations \+ consumer / retail frontline exposure \+ listed\-company governance (NRC, ESOP) \+ leadership hiring \& succession \+ multi\-entity, multi\-state compliance. Promoter\-led group experience is essential.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 As Group CHRO, you will lead the people agenda for the group and all its companies — from agri\-processing plants and steel mills to e\-waste, specialty chemicals, structured finance and a fast\-scaling retail and consumer care business. You will build one group HR architecture — shared values, governance, leadership pipeline and core policies — while letting each business run HR at its own pace: plant\- and IR\-led in manufacturing, high\-volume and frontline\-led at the retail venture. You will work closely with the Chairman, the promoter family, business CEOs, and the Board's Nomination \& Remuneration Committee.
 



  





 The Group CHRO carries direct onus for ensuring that every group business has the right leaders and the right people, at the right cost, to grow — this role is measured by business outcomes, not by HR policies alone.
 



  





**ROLE** 



* Own the group people strategy and HR charter across all group businesses and legal entities — org design, leadership talent, performance, rewards, industrial relations, compliance and HR operations.
* Build a group HR operating model: a lean corporate HR centre in Ahmedabad (policies, rewards, leadership talent, HR technology, governance) with business HR heads for each sector (agri, manufacturing, e\-waste, specialty chemicals, finance, and retail).
* Lead CXO and business\-head hiring, succession planning and talent reviews across the group — building a strong internal bench and working closely with the Chairman and promoter family on leadership continuity.
* Lead plant HR and industrial relations across processing units, refineries, mills, and manufacturing plants — contract labour, worker committees and unions, wage settlements, shift manpower and a strong safety culture.
* Enable the retail and consumer care venture's scale\-up to 400 stores through a dedicated HR lead — high\-volume store and frontline hiring, store incentives, training and retention, while protecting the lean, flat startup culture.
* Harmonise grades, compensation structures and benefits across group companies while keeping each competitive for its industry; own the design and administration of group ESOP plans.
* Partner the Board's Nomination \& Remuneration Committee on senior appointments, KMP remuneration, ESOPs and the HR disclosures required of a listed company.
* Ensure labour\-law compliance across every entity and state — Factories Act, Contract Labour Act, Shops \& Establishments, PF/ESIC, minimum wages, POSH, EHS and readiness for the new Labour Codes.
* Build one unified culture around core values of Care, Trust, Integrity, Honesty and Confidence — consistent across the group, yet flexible enough for each business to move at its own speed.
* Roll out a common group HRMS, multi\-entity payroll and people dashboards for every business.
* Drive performance and productivity — headcount planning, manpower cost as a percentage of revenue by business, and plant and store productivity — and own the group people budget.
* Lead talent mobility across group companies, set up HR for new ventures and acquisitions, and build a lean group HR team hands\-on.



  





**MUST HAVES** 



* 18\+ years in HR, including 7\+ years as CHRO or Group HR Head of a multi\-business group or diversified conglomerate.
* Deep plant HR and industrial relations experience in manufacturing or process industries (agri\-processing, metals, chemicals or similar), including contract labour and union handling.
* Exposure to a consumer, retail or D2C business with a large frontline workforce.
* Listed\-company experience — Nomination \& Remuneration Committee, KMP remuneration, ESOP administration and SEBI\-related HR disclosures.
* Proven record in leadership hiring, succession planning and org design across multiple businesses.
* Promoter\-led group experience — able to earn the trust of the Chairman and promoter family while working alongside professional CEOs.

**Disha Gandhi 📞 \+91 77108 44668 📧 disha.as@hrpc.in**

 A key objective of this role is to lead the end\-to\-end R\&D strategy, technology roadmap and product\-development execution for the Ophthalmic Instrumentation Division, covering diagnostic and treatment systems.
 



  





 The role is responsible for providing technical and organizational leadership across optical/opto\-mechanical design, electronics, embedded systems, firmware, software and systems integration; driving product development from concept through commercialization; ensuring design\-control and regulatory compliance; and establishing a high\-performing multidisciplinary instrumentation R\&D organization.
 



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




**Education** 




**Minimum:** 




 B.E./B.Tech, M.Tech, M.S. or Ph.D. in:
 


* Optics / Optical Engineering
* Biomedical Engineering
* Electronics



  





**Desirable:** 



* Advanced technical qualification with specialization in optical systems, biomedical instrumentation, electronics or medical\-device engineering.



  





**Experience Requirement** 




**Minimum:** 



* 10\+ years of progressive R\&D experience in medical\-device instrumentation.
* Significant hands\-on and leadership experience in ophthalmic diagnostic and/or treatment systems.
* Experience managing instrument development from concept through commercialization in a regulated environment.



**Desirable:** 



* Experience with systems such as:
* Biometers
* Topographers
* Tonometers
* OCT
* Fundus / anterior\-segment imaging systems
* Ophthalmic lasers
* Phacoemulsification systems
* Surgical consoles
* Experience leading multidisciplinary optics, electronics and embedded\-software teams.



  





**Role Requirements:** 



* Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, IEC 60601 series, IEC 62304, IEC 62366 and ISO 14971, with experience in design controls, verification and validation, and risk management for active/electromechanical devices.
* Proficiency in optical and opto\-mechanical design tools (Zemax or equivalent).
* Experience in international regulatory submissions (CDSCO, CE/MDR and US FDA) for diagnostic or treatment\-class medical devices.
* Proven track record in technology evaluation, build\-versus\-buy assessment, supplier/OEM partnerships, and licensing or technology\-transfer negotiations for instrumentation products.



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



1. Own the end\-to\-end R\&D strategy and technology roadmap for the Instrumentation Division, covering ophthalmic diagnostic and treatment systems.
2. Lead, build and mentor a multidisciplinary R\&D team spanning optical/opto\-mechanical design, electronics and embedded systems, software/firmware and systems integration.
3. Direct opto\-mechanical and electro\-optical system design for new diagnostic and treatment platforms using Zemax or equivalent optical\-design tools, ensuring that performance, manufacturability and cost targets are achieved.
4. Oversee embedded hardware, firmware and application\-software development and lifecycle management for connected diagnostic and treatment devices, ensuring compliance with IEC 62304 and applicable cybersecurity and data\-integrity requirements, including validation, release control and user documentation/IFUs.
5. Own design control and regulatory compliance for instrumentation R\&D in accordance with ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, IEC 60601\-1 (electrical, mechanical and thermal safety), IEC 60601\-1\-2 (EMC), applicable laser\-safety standards such as IEC 60825\-1, and ISO 14971 risk management.
6. Drive product development from concept through prototyping, verification and validation (V\&V), design transfer and commercialization for diagnostic and treatment systems.
7. Act as the senior technical interface with cross\-functional teams for domestic and international registrations (CDSCO, CE/MDR and US FDA, as applicable), audits, technical documentation and Design History Files.
8. Provide technical oversight to the manufacturing and service functions on instrumentation\-related issues, field complaints, CAPA and root\-cause investigations, driving continuous product and process improvement.
9. Direct clinical evaluation and usability\-engineering activities in accordance with IEC 62366, incorporating surgeon and clinician feedback into design iterations.
10. Lead technology scouting, evaluation and business development for the instrumentation portfolio, including assessment of build\-versus\-buy options, licensing, OEM and technology\-transfer opportunities, and strategic partnerships with instrument and component suppliers.
11. Build and maintain relationships with ophthalmic surgeons, hospitals and research institutions to support clinical trials, product validation, and market and technology intelligence.
12. Represent R\&D – Instrumentation in leadership and cross\-functional forums, providing technical inputs for business planning, budgeting, capital expenditure and new\-product introduction (NPI) decisions.
13. Establish and track departmental KPIs, project timelines and quality/reliability metrics for the instrumentation portfolio, and report progress and risks to senior leadership.
14. Ensure a strong quality, safety and compliance culture within the Instrumentation R\&D function, consistent with a regulated medical\-device manufacturing environment.



  





**Functional Skills Required** 



* In\-depth knowledge of opto\-mechanical and electro\-optical system design for ophthalmic diagnostic and treatment instruments.
* Expertise in embedded hardware, firmware and application\-software development in line with IEC 62304\.
* Ability to manage prototyping, verification and validation (V\&V) and design transfer for active/electromechanical devices.
* Experience in handling field complaints, CAPA and root\-cause investigations for instrumentation products.



  





**Behavioral Skills Required** 



* Strategic thinking with the ability to align the instrumentation roadmap with business goals.
* Strong leadership skills to build and mentor multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management with internal teams, suppliers, surgeons and institutions.
* Analytical problem\-solving and sound decision\-making under technical and commercial constraints.
* High ownership, accountability and a results\-driven approach to timelines and KPIs.
* Commitment to quality, safety and compliance.



  





**Team Size to be Handled:** 



* 3 direct reports at Senior Manager and Assistant Manager level.

description:
**Job Title: Lead AI Architecture** 




**Experience: 15\+ Years** 




**Department / Function: Technology D\&S** 




**Employment Type: Full\-time** 




  





**Position Overview:** 
 We are seeking a visionary AI Architect with 15\+ years of deep, hands\-on expertise to define and own the end\-to\-end architecture of our next\-generation AI platforms. This role will drive strategy and technical execution for large\-scale Sovereign AI initiatives spanning Computer Vision, Generative AI, LLMs/SLMs, RAG, and multi\-modal systems deployed across defence, enterprise, and public sector.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\)Technical Leadership:** 
 Architect and lead development of large\-scale AI systems covering:
 


* Computer Vision AI: Image \& video analytics, object detection/tracking, scene understanding, edge deployment for real\-time inference
* Generative AI: Text, audio, and video generation; diffusion models, GANs, transformers; multi\-modal synthesis
* Core ML: Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning, Active Learning pipelines from research to production



**2\)LLM/SLM \& RAG Platforms:** 
 Design and scale proprietary LLMs/SLMs, RAG frameworks, vector DBs, agentic workflows, and fine\-tuning pipelines for domain\-specific Sovereign AI models.
 



**3\)Sovereign AI:** 
 Lead initiatives for indigenous, secure, on\-prem AI stacks with data residency, compliance, and model auditability for strategic sectors.
 



**4\)Team Leadership:** 
 Build, mentor, and manage a team of 20\+ AI/ML engineers, research scientists, and MLOps specialists. Set technical standards, review architectures, and drive engineering excellence.
 



**5\)Project Delivery:** 
 Own architecture for complex, multi\-year programs involving data pipelines, training infra, GPU clusters, model serving at scale, and edge optimization
 



**6\)Cross\-functional Collaboration:** 
 Partner with product, data engineering, security, and business teams to translate mission requirements into scalable AI solutions
 



**7\)Innovation \& Governance:** 
 Evaluate SOTA research, publish patents, define AI governance, model risk, and ethical AI frameworks.
 



  





**Required Qualifications \& Skills** 




 1\)15\+ years hands\-on in AI/ML with proven end\-to\-end project implementation across Computer Vision, GenAI, and RL. At least 5 years in architectural leadership roles.
 



 Technical Depth:
 


* Expert in PyTorch/TensorFlow, CUDA, transformer architectures, diffusion models, YOLO/SAM, NeRFs, 3D vision
* Production experience with LLMs/SLMs: pre\-training, PEFT/LoRA/QLoRA, quantization, distributed training on 100\+ GPUs
* Strong RAG design: embeddings, rerankers, hybrid search, knowledge graphs, evaluation frameworks
* RLHF, Active Learning, continual learning, and MLOps: Kubeflow, MLflow, Ray, Triton, vLLM Deployed models at scale: \>10M inferences/day, latency \<100ms, edge devices Leadership: Managed and scaled teams of 20\+ AI engineers. Built hiring pipelines, OKRs, and technical career ladders



 2\)Domain: Experience with large\-scale public sector/defence projects preferred. • 3\)Understanding of data sovereignty, security clearances, and air\-gapped deployments is a plus
 



  





**Must\-have:** 



* M.Tech/PhD in CS, AI, ECE or related field from premier institute preferred.
* 15\+ years of hands\-on experience



  





**Skills \& Attributes** 



* Experience building foundation models from scratch
* Contributions to open\-source AI projects or top\-tier conferences
* Prior work with MoD, DPSUs, or critical infrastructure AI deployments
* Collaboration \& stakeholder management
* Integrity \& strong communication



  





**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to architect India’s Sovereign AI stack
* Access to large GPU clusters and petabyte\-scale datasets
* Leadership role with board visibility
* Competitive compensation \+ ESOPs \+ retention bonus
