title: Senior Platform Engineer (Architect)
description:
**Department:** 
 Engineering
   

  

**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad/GiftCity
   

  

**Description**
 Trading Technologies is in the middle of a massive infrastructure shift within the high\-stakes world of capital markets. We’re removing our legacy VMware datacenter, upgrading our Red Hat ecosystem, and modernizing our AWS footprint to support low latency, high\-performance trading systems. To pull this off, we’re restructuring our engineering org into dedicated Cloud and Platform teams.
   

  

 If you are looking to gain deep, hands\-on experience building the highly robust, low\-latency platforms that power capital markets, this is your chance.
   

  

 We need a Senior Platform Engineer to join the new Platform Team. Your main goal? Make life incredibly easy for our developers while maintaining the ironclad reliability our industry demands. We want to stop treating infrastructure as a ticketing system and start treating our platform as a product. To do that, we are making
 **Backstage** 
 the center of our universe, building it out as the core data model and source of truth for all of our platform engineering operations
   

  

 Role will be expected to be on call as part of the standard on call rotations.
   

  

**What Will You Be Involved With?**
* Own Backstage: You will architect and build out Backstage so it acts as our central software catalog, holding all the metadata, ownership data, and telemetry for our high\-performance engineering systems.
* Modernize Deployments: Our current deployment pipelines need an overhaul. You’ll help us move toward modern practices (GitOps, containerization, progressive delivery) so developers can ship code without friction—and without breaking critical financial workflows.
* Fix the DevEx: Build "golden paths" and self\-service tools that abstract away the complexity of AWS. If a developer needs infrastructure, they shouldn't have to wait for someone to click buttons.
* SRE in Capital Markets: Bring your deep Linux SRE expertise to an environment where microseconds matter. You’ll support the upgrade and optimization of our Red Hat (RHEL) environments while we actively migrate latency\-sensitive workloads off VMware and into a modernized AWS setup.
* Code the Infrastructure: Write clean, highly optimized Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK, etc.) to ensure everything we build is reproducible, version\-controlled, and tuned for maximum performance.
* Pipelines: create and improve the pipelines to drive quality, and ensure that what we deliver does not put our services at risk.


**What Will You Bring to the Table?**
* Experience: 7\+ years primarily focused on Platform Engineering, SRE, or modern DevOps.
* Platform \& DevEx Focus: You genuinely care about the developer experience. You have real experience building Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs), and ideally, you've gotten your hands dirty configuring Backstage plugins and data models.
* Linux / SRE Chops: You are a Linux expert, specifically with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL). You know how to tune the OS for performance, troubleshoot complex issues, and scale systems under heavy load.
* Cloud Modernization: You know your way around AWS and have a track record of moving workloads out of legacy on\-prem datacenters (especially VMware) into the cloud.
* Deployment Mastery: You are highly familiar with modern CI/CD, container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), and GitOps (ArgoCD/Flux).
* Scripting: You can write solid automation and tooling in Python, Go, TypeScript (helpful for Backstage), or Bash.


****Bonus Points****
* You’ve contributed to open\-source tools or built custom Backstage plugins.
* You know how to integrate complex telemetry (Datadog, Prometheus, etc.) directly into developer portals.
* Previous experience in Fintech, trading, or capital markets is great, but absolutely not required—we will teach you the domain.


**What We Bring To The Table**
* TT is a company in an exciting growth phase, having benefited from new ownership and investment over the last 5 years.
* A compelling suite of products, and plans for significant product development in 2026 and onwards.
* An established and mature core product offering, with a well known and well respected brand identity.
* A dynamic and positive company culture that fosters employee growth and rewards results. Comprehensive benefits package.


***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* Health \& Financial Security:
+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off \& Flexibility:
+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.
+ Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).

* Work\-Life Support \& Resources:
+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.

* Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:
+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.

* Our Culture:
+ Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.


 Trading Technologies (www.tradingtechnologies.com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market\-leading technology for the end\-to\-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) company delivers “multi\-X” solutions, with “X” representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi\-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post\-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. title: Senior Engineer - Design Verification
description:
**About SiFive**
*As the pioneers who introduced RISC\-V to the world, SiFive is transforming the future of compute by bringing the limitless potential of RISC\-V to the highest performance and most data\-intensive applications in the world. SiFive’s unrivaled compute platforms are continuing to enable leading technology companies around the world to innovate, optimize and deliver the most advanced solutions of tomorrow across every market segment of chip design, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, automotive, data center, mobile, and consumer. With SiFive, the future of RISC\-V has no limits.*
 At SiFive, we are always excited to connect with talented individuals, who are just as passionate about driving innovation and changing the world as we are.
   

  

 Our constant innovation and ongoing success is down to our amazing teams of incredibly talented people, who collaborate and support each other to come up with truly groundbreaking ideas and solutions. Solutions that will have a huge impact on people's lives; making the world a better place, one processor at a time.
   

  

 Are you ready?
   

  

 To learn more about SiFive’s phenomenal success and to see why we have won the GSA’s prestigious Most Respected Private Company Award (for the fourth time!), check out our website and Glassdoor pages.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**About The Role**
 SiFive is looking for a Senior Design Verification Engineer to drive verification of a next\-generation cache\-coherent interconnect subsystem used in high\-performance SoCs.
   

  

 This is a T3 / Senior Engineer individual\-contributor role within the Interconnect horizontal area, focused on coherent interconnect and related subsystem behavior.
   

  

 In this role, you will work across architecture, RTL, formal, and design verification teams to verify coherent data movement, protocol correctness, ordering, flow control, quality\-of\-service behavior, and subsystem integration across multiple interface types and bridge paths.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who can independently execute high\-quality verification work, build robust environments, debug complex issues efficiently, and contribute to stronger verification methodology across the broader interconnect verification effort.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Understand the coherent interconnect architecture and create effective verification strategies and test plans for the assigned area.
* Develop and maintain verification environments, checkers, scoreboards, assertions, stimulus, and coverage models for coherent traffic, ordering rules, backpressure, flow control, buffering behavior, and error handling.
* Verify subsystem behavior across interface boundaries, protocol adaptation layers, and bridge paths, including conversion, buffering, deinterleaving, and related data\-movement behavior.
* Define and execute directed and constrained\-random tests that expose corner cases in coherency, concurrency, ordering, credits, arbitration, QoS behavior, and integration scenarios.
* Analyze failures, isolate root cause, and drive fixes across RTL, assertions, testbench infrastructure, and test content.
* Collaborate closely with architecture, design, formal, and software teams to clarify requirements, review specifications, and improve verification quality early in the development cycle.
* Write functional coverage, analyze coverage results, and close coverage holes to ensure verification completeness and signoff quality.
* Contribute reusable methodology, automation, and debug improvements that raise team\-wide productivity and verification quality.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience in IP, subsystem, or SoC functional verification, preferably in coherent interconnect, cache, memory\-system, or CPU\-subsystem verification.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SystemVerilog and UVM\-based verification.
* Solid understanding of cache\-coherent systems, on\-chip interconnects, memory\-subsystem behavior, and verification of ordering and flow\-control semantics.
* Experience creating test plans, building testbenches, writing assertions, analyzing coverage, and debugging complex design issues.
* Experience verifying protocol behavior such as ordering, backpressure, buffering, arbitration, flow control, and error handling.
* Strong debugging skills and the ability to root\-cause issues across specification, RTL, and verification environment layers.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work effectively across architecture, design, and verification teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Direct experience verifying coherent interconnect, NoC, cache, or memory\-subsystem functionality in multicore or high\-performance SoCs.
* Experience with subsystem integration and protocol interactions across multiple interfaces or bridge paths.
* Familiarity with one or more industry protocols such as AXI, CHI, ACE, CXL, UCIe, or similar high\-performance interface standards.
* Familiarity with scripting and automation using Python or similar languages.
* Experience with formal verification, performance\-oriented verification, or emulation / FPGA\-assisted debug.
* Experience contributing reusable infrastructure or methodology improvements that benefit a broader DV team.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* Verification plans are complete and aligned with the highest architectural and protocol risks.
* Critical coherent\-interconnect bugs are found early, debugged efficiently, and closed with durable fixes.
* Coverage and verification quality improve meaningfully under your ownership.
* The coherent interconnect verification effort becomes more scalable, reusable, and predictable because of your contributions.
* Design and architecture teams rely on you as a strong technical partner for difficult protocol, coherency, and integration problems.


**Additional Information:**
 This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in:
   

  

 India
   

  

 Any offer of employment for this position is also contingent on the Company verifying that you are a authorized for access to export\-controlled technology under applicable export control laws or, if you are not already authorized, our ability to successfully obtain any necessary export license(s) or other approvals.
   

  

 SiFive is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Infrastructure Support Administrator
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Infrastructure Support Administrator
 



**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, India
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Shift Timings:** 
 6AM to 2\.30 PM, 9\.30 AM to 6 PM, Rollover days. 365 days a year.
 



**Working Days:** 
 5 Days
 



  
 



**About the Role**




 We are seeking a proactive Infrastructure Support Administrator to join our team. In this critical role, you will be the first line of defence for our server and cloud environment, ensuring high availability and performance during overnight hours.
 



 You will initially focus on monitoring and remediating alerts via PRTG, performing health checks on Windows/Linux servers, and supporting our Azure and Microsoft Entra environments. As the role evolves, you will take ownership of server patching and advanced infrastructure operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




 \- Monitoring \& Remediation: Monitor the PRTG dashboard, validate alerts, and execute documented runbooks to resolve incidents quickly.
 



 \- Troubleshooting: Perform root\-cause analysis for Windows Server issues (CPU, memory, services, Event Viewer) and basic Linux administration tasks.
 



 \- Cloud \& Identity Support: Support Azure VM health, networking, and monitor Entra ID sign\-in logs for authentication issues.
 



 \- Incident Management: Escalate complex incidents requiring specialized knowledge, vendor support, or production changes while documenting all actions taken.
 



 \- Maintenance: Participate in overnight maintenance activities and eventually execute approved patching workflows (Windows/Linux).
 



 \- Documentation: Maintain detailed incident notes, shift handoff summaries, and contribute to the improvement of knowledge articles and runbooks.
 



  
 



**Required Technical Skills**




 \- Windows Server: Strong troubleshooting skills (Event Viewer, Services, Task Manager, PowerShell) for performance and service\-related issues.
 



 \- Linux Admin: Basic command\-line proficiency (CPU, memory, disk usage, logs, SSH).
 



 \- Monitoring (PRTG): Experience with infrastructure monitoring tools; ability to distinguish between informational, warning, and critical alerts.
 



 \- Microsoft Azure: Knowledge of VMs, Resource Groups, Networking (VNETs/NSGs), and Azure Monitor.
 



 \- Microsoft Entra (Azure AD): Familiarity with user/group management, authentication logs, MFA, and Conditional Access.
 



  
 



**Preferred Experience**




 \- Experience with enterprise patching tools (e.g., Azure Update Manager, WSUS, MECM/SCCM).
 



 \- Understanding of backup validation and restore considerations.
 



 \- Familiarity with virtualized environments (VMware/Hyper\-V).
 



  
 



**Operational Requirements**




 \- Must be available for a consistent overnight shift.
 



 \- Excellent written communication skills for incident notes and shift handoffs.
 



 \- Ability to prioritize alerts based on business impact and follow security/compliance protocols rigorously.
 



  
 



**Why Join Us?**




 \- Career Growth: The role starts with monitoring and expands into patching, infrastructure ownership, and continuous improvement.
 



 \- Critical Impact: Directly influence the stability and security of our global infrastructure.
 



  
 



**Evaluation Criteria**




 Ideal candidates will demonstrate the ability to:
 



 \- Troubleshoot a Windows server with high CPU or low disk space.
 



 \- Investigate a PRTG alert and determine the appropriate action.
 



 \- Differentiate between an Azure resource issue and a guest OS issue.
 



 \- Explain a safe patching workflow from pre\-checks to post\-validation.
 



 \- Write a clear and concise shift handoff summary.
 



  





 Join our team and contribute to a collaborative, innovative environment, where your ideas can truly make a difference.
 



 We look forward to receiving your application

title: Creative Account Manager
description:
**Creative Account Manager** 




 Because — Ahmedabad · Full\-time · On\-site
 



  





 We're
 **Because** 
 — an AI\-native brand and marketing agency working across education, real estate, lifestyle, sports and financial services. This role is for someone who is genuinely two things at once: sharp enough to run client relationships, and creative enough to do the actual work. You'll own 4–6 accounts, report directly to a senior strategist, and be expected to think, write, plan, coordinate, and execute — often on the same day. If that sounds exhausting rather than exciting, this probably isn't the right fit.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* Manage 3–4 client accounts end\-to\-end — timelines, feedback cycles, approvals, and proactive communication. Clients should never have to follow up with you.
* Develop content strategy and campaign concepts — not just execute briefs, but help shape what the brief should be in the first place.
* Write copy across formats — social captions, scripts, brand messaging, ad copy, emailers — in English, Hindi, or Gujarati depending on the client.
* Build client presentations and strategy decks that make a clear argument and hold the room.
* Contribute to pitches — own your section, know the prospect's business, and present with conviction.
* Plan and coordinate shoots — brief photographers and videographers, prepare shot lists and call sheets, manage on\-ground logistics, and ensure the output matches the creative vision.
* Write scripts for reels, brand films, ads, and talking\-head content — punchy, platform\-aware, and on\-brief.
* Reference and brief designers and video editors with enough visual and tonal direction that they don't have to guess what you want.
* Manage social media hands\-on for select clients — content calendars, scheduling, captions, and community responses.
* Coordinate with external vendors — studios, talent, print vendors, photographers — and hold them to timelines and quality standards.



  





**You're a fit if** 



* You have 3–4 years at a creative or marketing agency and you've genuinely done both sides — not just one with a footnote of the other.
* You can write in at least two of the three: English, Hindi, Gujarati. Fluency in all three is a real advantage here.
* You can hold a client conversation in the morning, brief a designer at noon, review a script by evening, and not mix up which client is which.
* Your strategy thinking is grounded — you back ideas with audience insight, not just instinct.
* You've been on set. You know what a shot list is, how to manage a photographer who runs late, and what "we'll fix it in post" actually costs.
* You use AI tools actively — for copy drafts, research, referencing, strategy frameworks — and you've built your own workflow around them.
* You push back on bad briefs and bad ideas — politely, with reasoning — rather than just executing whatever lands in your inbox.
* Nothing falls through the cracks on your accounts. Not because someone's checking, but because that's just how you work.



  





  





**Work samples are mandatory.** 
 Share a deck you built, copy you wrote, a campaign you managed, or a shoot you coordinated.

title: Systems Administrator (Tier 3)
description:
**Company Overview**
 Outsourced is a leading ISO certified global offshore outsourcing company that provides dedicated remote staff to some of the world's leading international companies. Outsourced is recognized as one of the Best Places to Work and has achieved Great Place to Work Certification. We are committed to providing a positive and supportive work environment where all staff can thrive. As an Outsourced staff member, you will enjoy a fun and friendly working environment, competitive salaries, opportunities for growth and development, work\-life balance, and the chance to share your passion with a team of over 1000 talented professionals.
   

  

**Position Title:** 
**Systems Administrator, Tier 3**
**Location:** 
 India \- Onsite (preferably Ahmedabad or Bangalore)
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Working Hours:** 
 Nigh Shift \| 8:30 AM \- 5:00 PM PST (with on\-call rotation as required)
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an enthusiastic Tier 3 Systems Administrator to join our team. The Tier 3 Technicians are the third level escalation path for Tier 1 \& 2 support. In addition to providing a very high level of client service, you will develop strong relationships with clients and staff, provide user support to both local and remote users, maintain system documentation, and contribute to IT projects as required. Individuals applying for this position must be able to multi\-task, have a strong attention to detail, professional demeanor, and be able to adapt into a growing and changing environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Complete root cause tickets to find permanent and effective solutions, while recommending infrastructure improvements.
* Quickly assess and troubleshoot complex problems and devise effective solutions.
* Move clients onto private or public cloud\-based environments such as VMware on\-premises or Azure public cloud.
* Work with Management and other stakeholders to define, document, implement, monitor, and maintain network/system security and integrity.
* Troubleshoot and manage firewall, network, hardware, software, security, and VoIP incidents requiring resolution.
* Provide server infrastructure: build networks, set up DNS, DHCP, domain hosting, and virtualization software (Hyper\-V and VMware).
* Provide primary support and ongoing management of enterprise SAN storage technology such as 3PAR, Equallogic, Nutanix, Dell.
* Act as escalation point in troubleshooting and resolving Backup and DR technology such as Veeam Backup and Replication; including performing DR tests and documenting results.
* Design, configure, deploy, and set up complex networks in new and existing sites and locations.
* Provide expertise and specialized support to the installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of hardware and software, ensuring compatibility with existing systems and network.
* Conduct detailed analysis of network performance needed to maintain defined standards for clients, documenting findings and recommending hardware/software upgrades to increase network performance.
* Perform project work as required.
* Communicate ticket status and updates directly to clients.
* Assist with solutions on escalated tickets, update knowledge base, and use the opportunity to mentor the team and reduce escalations over time.
* Maintain flexibility to work outside regular hours when required to meet client deadlines.
* Consistently display superior customer service skills and telephone etiquette.
* Perform work in a high\-pressure team environment.
* Manage incident logging, workload, and documentation of support issues.
* Perform Active Directory user management (user accounts, security groups, distribution lists, passwords).
* Manage assets (inventory, repairs, configuring new machines).
* Troubleshoot and maintain IT hardware (iOS devices and Windows).
* Provide audio visual support (projectors, video conferencing, Zoom/Teams for Business).


**Requirements**
* Minimum 1\-3 years of experience in IT Service and Support industry.
* At least two professionally recognized certifications (Fortinet, Microsoft, Cisco, ITIL, etc.).
* Experience in setup and configuration of Windows servers, Virtualization environments with VMware/Hyper\-V, Azure virtualization, cloud\-based applications, and troubleshooting.
* Must have experience working with networking devices, switches, routers, video conference devices, and wireless.
* Intermediate to proficient knowledge of MS Office applications; Office 365 support experience including MS Teams (and Teams Calling), SharePoint/OneDrive for Business, and Exchange Online.
* Experience in managing, maintaining, and securing Azure and Microsoft Office 365 deployments; from MFA to Conditional Access or Intune.
* Knowledge of TCP/IP and routing protocols, layer 2 and layer 3 network design principles.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Extensive Microsoft environment knowledge including servers, licensing, AD, and DHCP.
* Extensive infrastructure knowledge, including networking, router/firewalls, servers, and workstations.
* Strong interpersonal skills with a polished and professional manner.
* Ability to deal with all levels of management.
* Excellent organizational skills with motivation, self\-direction, and good time management skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and deal with sensitive or difficult situations with tact and diplomacy.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Must be able to work remotely in Pacific Time Zone \- Vancouver, Canada.
* Comply with background check requirements.
* This position requires reliable internet connection, backup power, and the use of personal equipment such as desktop/laptop.


**Additional Skills or Assets**
* Experience with ConnectWise, ITGlue, PowerBI.
* Experience with Fortinet, Cisco IOS, Meraki, Ubiquity, Sonicwall, PFSense, etc.
* Experience with VDI, virtualization technologies, and cloud hosting.
* Experience with SolarWinds RMM tools (N\-able).
* Experience in Windows Virtual Desktop, Remote Desktop Services, or Citrix environments is advantageous.
* Understanding of DNS, especially as related to web and mail service.


**Success Metrics**
* Ticket resolution \- Timely and effective resolution of escalated Tier 3 tickets
* Client satisfaction \- Positive feedback from clients and internal stakeholders
* System uptime \- Maintain high availability and performance of client infrastructure
* Process improvement \- Identified and implemented infrastructure improvements and root cause fixes
* Team mentorship \- Reduced escalations through knowledge sharing and mentoring


**What We Offer** 
  

  

* Health Insurance: We provide medical coverage up to 20 lakh per annum, which covers you, your spouse, and a set of parents. This is available after one month of successful engagement.
* Professional Development: You'll have access to a monthly upskill allowance of ₹5000 for continued education and certifications to support your career growth.
* Leave Policy: Vacation Leave (VL): 10 days per year, available after probation. You can carry over or encash up to 5 unused days.
+ Casual Leave (CL): 8 days per year for personal needs or emergencies, available from day one.
+ Sick Leave: 12 days per year, available after probation.

* Flexible Work Hours or Remote Work Opportunities \- Depending on the role and project.
* Outsourced Benefits such as Paternity Leave, Maternity Leave, etc.

title: Managed Services Engineer
description:
Managed Services Engineer – Microsoft 365 \& Backup/DR
   

 Cobweb Ahmedabad Delivery Centre \| On\-site, Ahmedabad \| 4\+ years experience
   

  

 ABOUT THIS ROLE
   

  

 Cobweb MENA FZ LLC is a Microsoft Solutions Partner headquartered in Dubai, UAE, delivering managed IT services, NOC/SOC monitoring, Microsoft 365, Azure and AI\-enablement solutions to SMB and mid\-market clients across the MENA region.
   

  

 The Cobweb Ahmedabad delivery centre operates under the Cobweb MENA FZ LLC – Eccentric Business Intelligence Pvt Ltd associated partnership, extending Cobweb's engineering capability into India. Eccentric Business Intelligence is a cross\-border advisory and technology services firm headquartered in Ahmedabad, with operations across India, the UAE and the USA.
   

  

 This role is based full\-time at the Ahmedabad delivery centre, working as part of Cobweb's service delivery function on the MENA client portfolio. Functional reporting is to the Services Director, Cobweb MENA FZ LLC; site and day\-to\-day administration sit with the Ahmedabad delivery centre management.
   

  

 It is a client\-facing engineering role, not a back\-office ticket queue. You will prepare and present Quarterly Business Reviews directly to client stakeholders.
   

  

 WHAT YOU WILL DO
   

  

 Microsoft 365 tenant management
   

 • Administer multiple client Microsoft 365 tenants — Exchange Online, Entra ID, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, user and mailbox lifecycle, and licensing.
   

 • Configure and maintain conditional access, MFA, mail flow rules and baseline security policies across the tenant estate.
   

 • Lead tenant\-to\-tenant and Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migrations end to end, including mailbox, data, DNS and identity cutover.
   

 • Monitor tenant health and licence utilisation, and recommend optimisation proactively.
   

  

 Backup, business continuity and disaster recovery
   

 • Own day\-to\-day Acronis (or equivalent) backup operations: job configuration, monitoring, failure remediation and restore testing.
   

 • Support client Business Continuity Plans, including RPO/RTO definitions, backup schedules and retention policies.
   

 • Coordinate periodic DR and failover/restore testing, and document outcomes.
   

  

 Quarterly Business Reviews
   

 • Build QBR packs covering service performance, ticket trends, patching and compliance, backup/DR posture, security posture and recommendations.
   

 • Present QBRs directly to client stakeholders and follow action items through to closure.
   

  

 RMM, PSA and automation
   

 • Work daily in RMM tooling (N\-able, Datto, ConnectWise Automate or equivalent) to monitor, patch and remediate across managed endpoints and servers.
   

 • Log and manage tickets in PSA/ITSM tooling (ConnectWise Manage, Autotask, HaloPSA, ServiceNow or equivalent) with accurate time capture and SLA adherence.
   

 • Automate recurring tasks in PowerShell (Graph API and Azure CLI an advantage) and maintain runbooks and SOPs.
   

  

 General service delivery
   

 • Deliver Level 2/3 support on escalated incidents within agreed SLAs, following ITIL\-aligned incident, change and problem management.
   

 • Collaborate with the Dubai service delivery and NOC/SOC teams.
   

 • Contribute to new client onboarding, including discovery, documentation and tooling deployment.
   

  

 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
   

  

 • 4\+ years in an MSP, IT service desk or enterprise IT operations environment, with substantial hands\-on Microsoft 365 administration at scale.
   

 • Practical Acronis Cyber Protect or comparable backup platform experience, including restore and recovery operations.
   

 • Demonstrated experience leading tenant\-to\-tenant and Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migrations.
   

 • Proven ability to build and confidently deliver QBRs or similar client\-facing service reviews.
   

 • PowerShell scripting proficiency and solid RMM/PSA working knowledge.
   

 • Clear spoken and written English, with the confidence to engage MENA\-based clients directly.
   

 • Willingness to align working hours with Dubai/MENA business hours.
   

  

 MANDATORY CERTIFICATIONS
   

  

 Applications will only be considered from candidates holding both:
   

 • Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS\-102\) or equivalent, and
   

 • A Microsoft security certification — SC\-300, SC\-200 or the retired MS\-500\.
   

  

 NICE TO HAVE
   

  

 Azure administration (virtual machines, Intune, basic networking); Mimecast or Proofpoint; Exclaimer; prior MSP experience serving MENA or multi\-country client portfolios; NOC/SOC\-monitored environments; ITIL v4 Foundation, AZ\-900, Acronis or Mimecast certifications.
   

  

 EDUCATION
   

  

 Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
   

  

 WHAT WE OFFER
   

  

 • A diverse, multi\-country MENA client base as part of a growing Microsoft Solutions Partner.
   

 • A genuinely client\-facing engineering role, not a back\-office ticket queue.
   

 • Structured career growth across the Cobweb – Eccentric associated partnership, with close collaboration alongside the Dubai leadership and technical teams.
   

 • An established office environment and local engineering team at the Ahmedabad delivery centre.
   

 • Support for continued Microsoft and vendor certification.
   

 • Competitive compensation, commensurate with experience and certification profile.
   

  

 HOW TO APPLY
   

  

 Apply through LinkedIn with your CV. Please include your Microsoft 365 certification numbers and a brief summary of the largest migration you have led.
   

  

 Recruitment for the Cobweb Ahmedabad delivery centre is managed by Eccentric Business Intelligence Pvt Ltd under the associated partnership with Cobweb MENA FZ LLC. Shortlisted candidates will be assessed through a technical discussion covering M365 administration, backup/DR operations and a QBR scenario walkthrough.

title: RCM Ar
description:
**Company Description** 
 Zen Medical Services focuses on maximizing revenue for healthcare providers while reducing administrative burden and maintaining strict accuracy and compliance standards. The organization emphasizes timely cash flow by verifying active insurance coverage for every claim and ensuring correct ICD, CPT, and modifier usage. Teams closely track unpaid claims, targeting follow\-up within 30 days and keeping accounts receivable over 90 days below 5%. Daily monitoring of clearinghouse rejection logs and denial management helps maintain high claim acceptance rates and efficient reimbursement processes. This systematic approach supports reliable financial performance and consistent operational efficiency for clients.
 



**Role Description** 
 The RCM AR role at Zen Medical Services is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Ahmedabad. The role involves managing accounts receivable, reviewing and validating claims for accuracy, and ensuring that insurance information, coding, and modifiers are correctly applied. The RCM AR specialist will follow up on unpaid and denied claims, identify root causes, and coordinate with billing, coding, and client teams to resolve issues promptly. Daily responsibilities include monitoring A/R aging, maintaining targets for claims over 90 days, reviewing clearinghouse rejection logs, and updating documentation and systems to reflect current claim status. The role also requires maintaining compliance with payer guidelines, contributing to process improvements, and communicating clearly and professionally with internal stakeholders and, when needed, payers.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong knowledge of medical billing processes, revenue cycle management, and accounts receivable follow\-up.
* Understanding of insurance verification, payer guidelines, and denial management procedures.
* Familiarity with ICD, CPT, and modifier usage, and ability to identify coding\-related issues impacting reimbursement.
* Experience working with billing software, clearinghouse platforms, and A/R reporting tools.
* Attention to detail, analytical thinking, and ability to interpret A/R aging reports and claim status data.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to work on\-site in Ahmedabad, manage time efficiently, and handle multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Previous experience in RCM, AR follow\-up, or medical billing is preferred; a related diploma or degree in healthcare, finance, or business is an advantage.

title: Chip Conveyor Service Enginner
description:
**Company Description** 
 Miven Mayfran Conveyors Pvt Ltd is a leading provider of chip, scrap, and coolant management solutions that help manufacturing facilities maintain clean, efficient, and future\-ready shop floors. As a long\-standing joint venture between Mayfran International and the Sirur Group, and part of the global Tsubakimoto Chain Group, the company combines international engineering expertise with deep Indian manufacturing experience. Its portfolio includes chip and scrap conveyors, magnetic and screw conveyors, separator conveyors, coolant filtration systems, chip crushers and shredders, chip centrifuges, and centralized handling and processing systems. For nearly four decades, Miven Mayfran has supported India’s metalworking, automotive, machine tool, and auto\-component industries by transforming waste into value and enabling smarter, more sustainable factories. The company focuses on smart manufacturing, clean shop floors, industrial automation, and intelligent scrap and coolant management.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for a Chip Conveyor Service Engineer based in Ahmedabad. The Chip Conveyor Service Engineer will perform installation, commissioning, maintenance, and repair of chip and scrap conveyor systems and associated coolant management equipment at customer locations. Daily responsibilities include diagnosing mechanical and electrical issues, executing troubleshooting and corrective actions, and providing technical support and guidance to customer maintenance teams. The role involves conducting preventive maintenance, preparing service reports, coordinating spare parts requirements, and ensuring timely resolution of field service calls. The engineer will collaborate with internal engineering and sales teams, follow safety and quality standards, and contribute to customer training and continuous improvement of service processes.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills for mechanical and basic electrical systems in industrial machinery.
* Hands\-on field service experience, including on\-site installation, commissioning, and customer support.
* Ability to provide technical support, including interpreting drawings, manuals, and specifications.
* Experience in maintenance and repair of conveyors, material handling systems, or similar industrial equipment.
* Clear and professional communication skills for interacting with customers, vendors, and internal teams.
* ITI or Diploma in Mechanical or related engineering discipline.
* Familiarity with safety standards and best practices in industrial environments.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites as required and work flexible hours when needed.
* Knowledge of chip, scrap, or coolant management systems and CNC shop floor operations is an advantage.
* Basic computer skills for service documentation, reporting, and use of service management tools.

title: Credit Analyst | Fixed Income
description:
We are looking for an experienced Credit Analyst to join our Fixed Income. The role will be responsible for evaluating credit opportunities, conducting detailed financial and business analysis, assessing issuer creditworthiness, and providing insights to support investment and transaction decisions across the fixed\-income portfolio.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Conduct detailed credit analysis of corporates, NBFCs, financial institutions and other debt issuers.
* Analyse financial statements, cash flows, leverage, liquidity, profitability, capital structure and debt\-servicing capability.
* Evaluate bonds, NCDs, structured debt, private placements and other fixed\-income instruments.
* Prepare comprehensive credit appraisal notes, issuer profiles, investment memos and transaction analyses.
* Assess credit risks, industry dynamics, business risks, financial risks and promoter/management strength.
* Analyse existing and proposed debt structures, security cover, collateral, guarantees, covenants and repayment mechanisms.
* Conduct financial modelling, ratio analysis, sensitivity analysis and stress testing.
* Monitor issuer performance, financial results, rating actions, industry developments and other material credit events.
* Track and analyse credit ratings, rating rationale and rating\-agency reports.
* Provide independent views on credit quality, risk\-return considerations and suitability of debt opportunities.
* Support evaluation of new issuers and identify potential investment / transaction opportunities.
* Work closely with debt capital markets, sales, dealing, investment, risk, legal and compliance teams for transaction evaluation and execution.
* Participate in management/issuer discussions, due diligence and credit review meetings.
* Prepare investor presentations, credit briefs, teasers and other transaction\-related materials.
* Maintain ongoing monitoring reports and early\-warning indicators for existing exposures.
* Keep abreast of interest rates, credit spreads, bond yields, regulatory developments and macroeconomic trends impacting fixed\-income markets.



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong understanding of Credit Analysis and Fixed Income markets.
* Good knowledge of debt instruments, bond structures, credit ratings, covenants and security mechanisms.
* Strong ability to analyse financial statements and assess creditworthiness.
* Excellent financial modelling and analytical capabilities.
* Strong understanding of corporate finance and capital structure.
* Ability to interpret rating\-agency reports and industry research.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to form independent analytical views.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, transaction\-oriented environment.



  





**Preferred Experience : 2 to 5 Years** 




 Candidates with experience in Credit Research, Fixed Income, Investment Banking, Credit Rating Agencies, Banks, NBFCs, Asset Management or Corporate Finance will be preferred.
 



  





**Educational Qualification** 




 CA / CFA / MBA / PGDM – Finance / relevant financial qualification from a reputed institution.
 



  





**Key Success Measures** 



* Quality and depth of credit assessments
* Accuracy of financial and credit analysis
* Timely completion of credit notes and investment evaluations
* Effective identification of credit risks and early\-warning signals
* Quality of issuer and industry research
* Contribution to sound fixed\-income investment and transaction decision

title: Senior SAP Basis Consultant
description:
**Position Overview:** 




 We are seeking an experienced
 **Senior SAP BASIS Consultant** 
 with
 **7\+ years of hands\-on experience** 
 in managing, architecture, and supporting complex SAP technical landscapes. The ideal candidate will be responsible for end\-to\-end SAP system administration, HANA database management, system performance optimization, upgrades, and multi\-system integrations across both cloud and on\-premise deployments.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* **System Administration \& Maintenance:** 
 Lead the installation, configuration, patching, kernel updates, and daily technical administration of complex SAP landscapes (ECC, S/4HANA, Solution Manager, BW, NetWeaver, PO/PI).
* **Database Management:** 
 Oversee SAP HANA (and traditional databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or Sybase ASE) administration, including memory management, backup/recovery strategies, high availability (HA), disaster recovery (DR), and performance tuning.
* **Landscape Architecture \& Strategy:** 
 Design, implement, and maintain system landscapes, transport management systems (TMS), client strategy, and system refreshes/copies across multi\-tiered environments.
* **Upgrades \& Migrations:** 
 Lead OS/DB migrations, S/4HANA conversion projects, system copies, and application of Support Package Stacks (SPS) and Enhancement Packs (EhP).
* **Performance Monitoring \& Tuning:** 
 Utilize SAP EarlyWatch Alerts (EWA), Wily Introscope, and CCMS to proactively monitor system health, optimize workload parameters, and perform root\-cause analysis (RCA) on performance bottlenecks.
* **Security \& Governance:** 
 Manage user access administration, GRC integration, SSO configuration, certificate installations, and enforce transport security and segregation of duties (SoD).
* **Cloud \& Hybrid Integration:** 
 Manage cloud hosting setups (AWS, Azure, GCP, or SAP RISE/Cloud ALM) and ensure seamless hybrid connectivity.



 Skills Required Specifically for a Senior SAP BASIS Consultant
 



 Technical Skills
 


* **Core SAP BASIS Administration:**
* SAP S/4HANA, ECC 6\.0, NetWeaver ABAP/JAVA stacks administration.
* Deep expertise in Transport Management System (TMS/eTMS) and ChaRM.
* SAP Solution Manager 7\.2 / SAP Cloud ALM setup, Monitoring, Focused Run, and EWA configuration.
* **HANA \& Database Administration:**
* SAP HANA Administration (HANA Studio, Cockpit, memory management, scale\-up/scale\-out architectures).
* Experience with traditional DBs (MS SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, Sybase ASE).
* Database Backup, Restore, Point\-in\-Time Recovery, System Replication (HSR), and Disaster Recovery testing.
* **OS \& Platform Expertise:**
* High proficiency in Enterprise Linux (SUSE / RedHat Linux) and Windows Server operating systems.
* OS\-level shell scripting (Bash, PowerShell) for task automation.
* **System Lifecycle \& Upgrades:**
* Software Update Manager (SUM), Database Migration Option (DMO), and SPAM/SAINT execution.
* System Refreshes / Client Copies (BDLS execution, post\-refresh automation).
* **Security \& Integration:**
* Single Sign\-On (SSO) configuration (SAML 2\.0, Kerberos, SSL/TLS certificates).
* Interface administration (SAP PO/PI, Cloud Connector, RFCs, Web Dispatcher).



 Domain \& Professional Competencies
 


* **7\+ Years of Experience:** 
 Proven background as a primary technical owner for enterprise SAP environments.
* **Troubleshooting \& RCA:** 
 Strong diagnostic skills for analyzing short dumps, lock entries, system logs, and HANA trace files.
* **Disaster Recovery (DR):** 
 Expertise in setting up, maintaining, and testing high\-availability and disaster recovery architectures.
* **Communication \& Mentorship:** 
 Ability to guide cross\-functional functional teams, interface with infrastructure teams, and mentor junior BASIS engineers.

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth.  We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Treasury Cash Management professional to lead cash accounting, bank reconciliations, payment controls and banking operations within a complex, multi\-entity environment based in Ahmedabad. This role combines treasury operations expertise with digital transformation capabilities to improve financial control, operational efficiency and automation. The successful candidate will work closely with Finance, Technology, Risk, Cyber Security, banking partners and external providers to build scalable, technology\-enabled treasury processes while ensuring accurate accounting, regulatory compliance and strong governance.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Lead Cash Accounting and Reconciliations
   

  

* Own daily and period\-end cash accounting, ensuring transactions are complete, accurate and appropriately recorded in the ERP and relevant sub\-ledgers
* Lead reconciliations across bank statements, payment platforms, collection files, clearing accounts, cash\-in\-transit accounts and the general ledger
* Drive timely resolution of unmatched, duplicated, rejected, returned and aged items with appropriate ownership and supporting documentation
* Establish consistent standards for reconciliation frequency, ageing, review, certification, evidence retention and escalation


 Own Bank Reconciliations and Banking Operations
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end bank reconciliations across bank accounts, entities and currencies
* Ensure bank statements and transaction files are received completely and processed accurately through approved connectivity channels
* Oversee bank account postings, charges, collections, direct debits, payment returns, unidentified receipts and related accounting treatment
* Manage bank account administration, mandates, signatories, access governance and periodic user access reviews
* Collaborate with banks and internal teams to resolve statement, interface, value\-date and transaction discrepancies


 Strengthen Payments, Controls and Financial Close
   

  

* Oversee secure and timely payment processing, including file validation, approvals, release controls and accounting for payment outcomes
* Monitor failed, rejected, duplicate, delayed and returned payments and lead root cause resolution
* Lead month\-end cash and banking close activities, including journal reviews, reconciliation certification, aged\-item reporting and balance sheet commentary
* Maintain robust segregation of duties, maker\-checker processes, access controls, audit trails and control evidence


 Drive FinTech and Digital Transformation
   

  

* Identify and implement automation opportunities across matching, reconciliations, exception management, reporting and bank administration
* Lead implementation and enhancement initiatives across Treasury Management Systems, reconciliation platforms, ERP modules, workflow solutions and payment technologies
* Advance API\-based and host\-to\-host banking connectivity and straight\-through processing where appropriate
* Apply analytics, AI\-assisted matching, anomaly detection and rules\-based automation to improve control effectiveness and reduce manual effort
* Own business requirements, process design, user acceptance testing, deployment readiness and benefit realisation activities for treasury technology initiatives


 Lead People and Stakeholder Relationships
   

  

* Coach, support and develop the Treasury Cash Management team, strengthening accounting, reconciliation, controls and digital capabilities
* Partner with Finance, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Controllership, Technology, Cyber Security, Risk, banking partners, FinTech providers and auditors
* Lead governance reviews, communicate risks and issues clearly, and ensure actions are tracked and completed


**Who You Are**
* Typically bring 6 to 12 years of experience in treasury operations, cash and banking, financial operations or shared services environments, including people leadership responsibilities
* Demonstrate experience managing high\-volume cash and bank reconciliations within multi\-entity and/or multi\-currency organisations
* Possess strong knowledge of cash accounting, payment processing, clearing accounts, month\-end close processes, balance sheet controls and reconciliation governance
* Have hands\-on experience with ERP systems, Treasury Management Systems, bank connectivity solutions, reconciliation platforms, workflow tools and automation technologies
* Bring experience in process standardisation, requirements gathering, testing, implementation, change management and benefits realisation
* Exhibit strong stakeholder management, analytical thinking, communication and problem\-solving capabilities
* Hold a professional qualification such as CA, CPA, CMA, MBA Finance, CIMA, ACCA or an equivalent qualification


**Preferred Digital And FinTech Capabilities**
* Experience with API\-based or host\-to\-host banking connectivity and straight\-through processing
* Practical exposure to automated matching, workflow automation, rules engines, RPA, AI\-assisted reconciliation or anomaly detection solutions
* Advanced Excel skills and reporting expertise using Power BI, Qlik or comparable analytics tools
* Working knowledge of SQL, data structures, integrations or automation platforms

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- System Scalability:
   

  

 –Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
   

  

 –Optimize code and/or systems for large\-scale data processing and high\-throughput requirements to support hyper\-scale systems.
   

  

 –Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
   

  

 –Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
   

  

 –Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large\-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
   

  

 –Design performance and load testing.
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Design:
   

  

 –Build and design fault\-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in\-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
   

  

 –Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
   

  

 –Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load\-shedding, throttling, and rate\-limiting.
   

  

 –Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Performance:
   

  

 –Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
   

  

 –Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- Correctness / Availability:
   

  

 –Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
   

  

 –Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault\-injection, brown\-out) to evaluate system correctness.
   

  

 –Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
   

  

 Operational Troubleshooting \& Incident Management:
   

  

 –Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
   

  

 –Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
   

  

 –Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
   

  

 –Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
   

  

 –Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
   

  

 Compliance \& Security:
   

  

 –Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi\-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
   

  

 –Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
   

  

 –Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
   

  

 Automation \& Change Management:
   

  

 –Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
   

  

 –Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

 Planning \& Execution:
   

  

 –Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately\-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
   

  

 Collaboration \& Partnership:
   

  

 –Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
   

  

 Problem Solving:
   

  

 –Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
   

  

 Continuous Learning:
   

  

 –Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
   

  

 Continuous Improvement:
   

  

 –Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
   

  

 Performance and Development:
   

  

 –Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC4

title: Senior Manager, Application Development
description:
**Job Description**
* Execute CSV activities for SAP implementation, enhancement, upgrade, integration, and support projects.
* Participate in validation planning and determine validation requirements based on system criticality, intended use, GxP impact, and risk.
* Support preparation, review, and approval of validation deliverables such as:
+ Validation Plan / Master Validation Plan inputs.
+ GxP and system impact assessments.
+ Computerized System Risk Assessments.
+ User Requirements Specifications (URS).
+ Functional and Design Specifications, where applicable.
+ Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM).
+ Test plans, test scripts, test protocols, and test evidence.
+ Installation, Operational, and Performance Qualification documentation, where applicable.
+ Validation Summary Reports.
+ Standard Operating Procedures and Work Instructions.

* Review SAP business and functional requirements to ensure applicable GxP, quality, regulatory, and data integrity requirements are adequately addressed.
* Ensure requirements are clear, testable, traceable, and appropriately linked to business and regulatory risks.
* Support risk\-based validation and testing strategies to avoid unnecessary testing while ensuring adequate control of GxP\-critical functionality.
* Review SAP configuration, custom developments, workflows, reports, forms, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, and integrations from a CSV/GxP perspective.
* Participate in SAP testing activities including:
+ Functional testing.
+ System Integration Testing (SIT).
+ User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
+ Regression testing.
+ GxP/validation testing.

* Review executed test evidence for completeness, accuracy, traceability, objective evidence, and compliance with validation procedures.
* Ensure test deviations, incidents, and defects are documented, investigated, resolved, and appropriately assessed for GxP impact.
* Support validation of SAP interfaces with external or third\-party applications and ensure appropriate controls for data transfer, reconciliation, error handling, and audit trail.
* Assess and document data integrity controls including ALCOA\+ principles, audit trails, electronic records, electronic signatures, access controls, and record retention.
* Support evaluation of SAP roles, authorization controls, segregation of duties, and privileged access where relevant to GxP processes.
* Participate in SAP data migration validation including source\-to\-target mapping, data verification, reconciliation, completeness, and accuracy checks.
* Support assessment and validation of SAP master data and transactional data impacting regulated business processes.
* Participate in validation of applicable SAP modules/processes such as:
+ Materials Management (MM).
+ Production Planning (PP).
+ Quality Management (QM).
+ Plant Maintenance / Asset Management (PM/EAM).
+ Extended Warehouse Management (EWM).
+ Finance and Controlling where GxP relevance exists.
+ SAP Fiori applications and workflows.
+ SAP integrations and interfaces.

* Work with SAP functional and technical teams to ensure validation requirements are embedded throughout the system development lifecycle.
* Support change controls and perform GxP/validation impact assessments for SAP enhancements, configuration changes, patches, upgrades, and releases.
* Support periodic reviews of validated SAP systems to confirm continued validated state.
* Support incident, problem, deviation, CAPA, and change\-management processes affecting validated systems.
* Assist in maintaining validation documentation throughout the system lifecycle and ensure controlled documentation is current and audit ready.
* Support system decommissioning and archival activities where required.
* Participate in internal audits, regulatory inspections, customer audits, and supplier audits involving computerized systems.
* Provide validation documentation and evidence during inspections and respond to auditor/inspector queries as required.
* Ensure validation activities comply with organizational SOPs, Quality Management System requirements, and approved project methodology.
* Coordinate with Quality Assurance for review and approval of validation documents and resolution of compliance observations.
* Support qualification and assessment of SAP vendors, System Integrators, cloud/service providers, and third\-party technology suppliers where applicable.
* Promote standardized CSV practices and consistent validation methodology across SAP projects and geographical locations.
* Identify validation risks early and escalate gaps that may impact regulatory compliance, data integrity, testing, or project go\-live readiness.


**Qualifications**
* Any bachelor's or master's degree from a recognized institution.
* SAP certification in any relevant functional or technical area is preferred but not mandatory.
* CSV, GAMP 5, Quality, ISPE, or regulatory compliance certification is advantageous.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, particularly Cloud Private Edition or large\-scale global SAP transformation programs, is preferred.
* Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality, warehouse, supply chain, laboratory, or regulated business processes is desirable.

title: Executive Personal Assistant
description:
**About the Role** 




 The Founder is looking for a highly organised, responsible and presentable Executive Personal Assistant who can function as an extension of the Founder’s Office.
 



 This is not a conventional desk\-based PA role. The selected candidate will organise the Founder’s professional and personal commitments, coordinate with vendors and third parties, manage calendars and reminders, maintain financial and administrative records, coordinate authorised payments and banking work, and accompany the Founder whenever required.
 



 The person will also support the Founder’s personal brand by capturing photographs, videos and important moments during meetings, events, visits and professional engagements. The ideal candidate should be proactive, discreet, highly dependable and capable of representing the Founder professionally in different environments.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Calendar, Schedule \& Commitment Management** 




 Manage appointments, meetings, calls and professional engagements.
 



 Schedule and reschedule meetings based on priorities.
 



 Maintain daily, weekly and monthly calendars covering professional and personal commitments.
 



 Prevent scheduling conflicts and missed commitments.
 



 Block preparation and travel time wherever required.
 



 Confirm appointments with relevant parties.
 



 Track important events, deadlines and follow\-ups.
 



 Prepare the Founder’s schedule in advance.
 



*The Founder should always have clarity on what needs to be done today, this week and this month.* 




**2\. Daily, Weekly \& Monthly Task Management** 




 Record tasks discussed throughout the day.
 



 Maintain pending, ongoing and completed task lists.
 



 Set reminders for deadlines, commitments and recurring responsibilities.
 



 Follow up with relevant people until assigned tasks are completed.
 



 Identify overdue items and bring them to the Founder’s attention.
 



 Prepare priorities for the following day.
 



**3\. Vendor \& Third\-Party Communication** 




 Act as a professional coordination point on behalf of the Founder and the Wellness Centre.
 



 Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, agencies and service providers.
 



 Handle appointment coordination, documentation follow\-ups, quotations and invoices.
 



 Maintain vendor records and follow up on committed timelines and deliverables.
 



 Communicate professionally through calls, WhatsApp, email and in\-person meetings.
 



 Coordinate with third parties on behalf of the Founder, except personal, confidential or VVIP contacts unless specifically delegated.
 



**4\. Founder Representation \& Coordination** 




 Accompany the Founder for meetings, events, professional visits and other engagements when required.
 



 Represent the Founder’s Office appropriately whenever delegated.
 



 Interact confidently and courteously with professionals, senior stakeholders and service providers.
 



 Exercise sound judgement regarding when to communicate, escalate or maintain confidentiality.
 



**5\. Expense \& Financial Administration** 




 Maintain organised records of Wellness Centre\-related and authorised personal financial transactions.
 



 Record and categorise expenses and maintain bills and receipts.
 



 Maintain vendor payment records, pending payment trackers and recurring expense schedules.
 



 Record advances and reimbursements and coordinate supporting invoices and documents.
 



 Prepare basic expense summaries and perform basic reconciliation of payments, bills and records.
 



 Coordinate with accountants or finance professionals when required.
 



*This role involves basic financial checking and reconciliation, but does not replace statutory accounting or professional financial auditing.* 




**6\. Payment Management** 




 Maintain a proper payment tracker for vendor payments, utility bills, subscriptions, professional payments, personal recurring bills, Wellness Centre\-related payments and renewals.
 



 Prepare and coordinate authorised payments and ensure supporting documentation is maintained.
 



 Execute payments only with appropriate authorisation from the Founder.
 



 Track due dates so important payments are not missed.
 



**7\. Banking \& Administrative Work** 




 Visit banks when required for authorised work.
 



 Submit and collect authorised documents and coordinate bank\-related paperwork.
 



 Maintain records of banking correspondence and follow up on requirements.
 



 Coordinate cheque, deposit and documentation\-related tasks as assigned.
 



 Maintain reminders for banking and financial commitments.
 



*High\-value or sensitive financial decisions will remain under the Founder’s authority.* 




**8\. Personal Branding \& Content Capture** 




 Take photographs during professional engagements and important activities.
 



 Record short videos, behind\-the\-scenes moments and raw content for social media.
 



 Capture meetings, events, professional visits and Founder interactions where appropriate.
 



 Maintain organised folders of photographs and videos.
 



 Share raw assets with the marketing or digital team in a timely manner.
 



 Maintain basic awareness of framing, lighting, composition and video orientation.
 



*The PA is not expected to be a professional photographer or video editor, but should have a good eye for capturing usable social\-media and digital\-marketing content.* 




**9\. Meeting \& Follow\-up Management** 




 Confirm participants, venue, time and relevant information before meetings.
 



 Remind the Founder of upcoming meetings and ensure travel arrangements where necessary.
 



 Record key action points, commitments, deadlines and follow\-ups during or immediately after meetings.
 



 Coordinate post\-meeting follow\-ups and track pending actions until closure.
 



**10\. Personal Administrative Support** 




 Coordinate personal appointments, bills, expenses, travel, documentation and renewals as assigned.
 



 Handle reasonable purchase or vendor coordination and maintain reminders for important personal commitments.
 



 Reduce administrative burden so the Founder can focus on business, leadership and strategic priorities.
 



  





**Reporting Rhythm** 




**DAILY** 





 Appointments, priorities, pending follow\-ups and important reminders.
 




**WEEKLY** 





 Completed tasks, pending tasks, upcoming meetings, payments and commitments.
 




**MONTHLY** 





 Important commitments, payments, expenses, renewals, recurring obligations and pending administrative matters.
 




**Essential Skills** 




 Excellent organisation, task management and follow\-up discipline.
 



 Strong calendar and appointment\-management skills.
 



 High attention to detail and accuracy.
 



 Good verbal and written communication.
 



 Basic understanding of accounts, expenses, bills, invoices and payment records.
 



 Comfortable using Excel or Google Sheets, Google Calendar or similar scheduling tools, email and WhatsApp.
 



 Basic smartphone photography and videography skills.
 



 Ability to maintain organised digital files and documentation.
 



 Strong time management, multitasking and problem\-solving ability.
 



 Professional etiquette, discretion and ability to work independently.
 



  





**Mandatory Driving Requirement** 




**Knowing how to drive a four\-wheeler is mandatory.** 




 Hold a valid driving licence.
 



 Be confident driving locally and to nearby areas.
 



 Be comfortable accompanying the Founder for meetings, events and professional commitments.
 



 Be willing to travel locally as part of the role.
 



**Preferred Candidate Profile** 




 Extremely organised, dependable and proactive.
 



 Comfortable working closely with a Founder in a high\-trust role.
 



 Presentable, professionally groomed and mature in communication.
 



 Strong at follow\-ups and comfortable coordinating multiple stakeholders.
 



 Financially disciplined and detail\-oriented.
 



 Digitally comfortable and quick to learn new systems.
 



 Flexible in a dynamic environment where priorities may change.
 



 Able to distinguish between urgent, important and routine tasks.
 



  





**Confidentiality** 




 This position will provide access to sensitive business, personal and financial information. The selected candidate will be expected to maintain strict confidentiality regarding:
 



 Business information and internal discussions.
 



 Banking information and financial records.
 



 Personal expenses and personal matters.
 



 Client, vendor and contact information.
 



 Meetings, conversations and travel schedules.
 



 Business strategies and confidential documentation.
 



 A confidentiality or NDA agreement may form part of the employment terms.
 



**Success in This Role Means** 




 The Founder does not miss important meetings, commitments or deadlines.
 



 Tasks, reminders and follow\-ups are consistently tracked to closure.
 



 Vendors and external parties receive timely and professional communication.
 



 Payment deadlines are not missed and financial records remain organised.
 



 Calendar conflicts are minimised and meetings result in clear action points.
 



 Personal and business administrative records remain structured and accessible.
 



 Content\-worthy professional moments are consistently captured.
 



 The Founder has a clear daily view of priorities, meetings and pending actions.
 



 The Founder is able to focus more strongly on business growth while administrative responsibilities remain organised.
 



  





**ROLE SUMMARY** 




**You will be the organisational backbone of the Founder’s Office.** 
 From calendars, reminders and meetings to vendors, payments, banking, expenses, follow\-ups and content capture, your responsibility is to ensure important details do not get missed and the Founder’s professional and administrative life remains structured and efficiently managed.
 




 Executive Personal Assistant \| Founder’s Office \| Wellness Centre
